August marks many important milestones in the history of the fight for a healthy and just democracy, such as the anniversaries of the Voting Rights Act and the March on Washington.

And today, voting rights and our democratic ideals are under unprecedented attack. Donald Trump continues to push the “Big Lie,” claiming the 2020 election was rigged, and in Congress, Scott Perry voted to throw out our votes on Jan. 6th, voted against taking dark money out of politics and is blazing forward with an extremist MAGA agenda.

This division does not move our communities forward. As I travel the district listening to residents from all walks of life, I hear this concern again and again. Americans desperately want to be heard by a government that takes action; one that solves problems and delivers on its promises.

body:
Tonight’s debate is a sham.
| | |
---
| | | [ ](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=4482f3c061&e=0be619cbaa)

|
# I’m suing the RNC.
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Friends, There’s no two ways about it: the Republican National Committee wants to silence your voice. [**I won’t let them silence you. But, I need your help to fight back.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=e9373b8919&e=0be619cbaa) Folks, I knew the game was rigged, but I could have never guessed it was this bad. I worked hard to tell Americans about my vision for a new American Golden Age, and tens of thousands of patriots like you responded. We gave everything we had to earn a spot on that debate stage, and we did everything that was required to qualify. In America, we believe in fairness and the equal application of rules for everyone. I guess the RNC doesn’t agree. For some reason, the establishment leaders at the RNC are afraid of having my voice – your voice! – heard in this primary process. They must be afraid that a political outsider like me would have the courage it takes to change things in Washington. Just as I had to fight tirelessly to be on the ballot in the California Recall election, I will fight to secure my rightful place on that debate stage because, together, you and I earned it. [**We can stop them from getting away with this, but I need your help! Use your campaign contribution to send a message to the RNC that your voice will not be silenced!**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=fd05ba38b1&e=0be619cbaa) The facts don’t lie. Remember:
* We **EXCEEDED** the RNC’s requirement of at least 40,000 individual donors;
* We **EXCEEDED** the RNC’s requirement of 200 donors in 20 states (our team nearly doubled that, with 200+ donors in at least 37 states);
* We **MET** the RNC’s polling requirement of at least 1% in select polls, and we provided the detailed cross tabs of such polls.

Despite meeting or exceeding all these requirements, the RNC is shutting us out, informing us that the extremely reputable and historically correct Rasmussen Poll we included in our package is invalid, in part because of its ties to former President Trump, who won’t be participating in the debates. This is despite the fact that RASMUSSEN WAS ONE OF ONLY THREE polling companies to accurately predict the results of the 2016 election. Make no mistake: **This is an effort to disenfranchise YOU, and I’m not going to stand for it.** That’s why I’m filing suit against the RNC, to ensure your voice is heard on that debate stage. [**Donate what you can TODAY to tell the RNC you won’t be pushed aside.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=f2976fbf2d&e=0be619cbaa) Thank you,
Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President
---

[**P.S. Unlike all the career politicians and billionaires, I’m an independent conservative voice who’s fighting for you, and together, we can turn the tide. Will you help me?**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=333b048c4d&e=0be619cbaa)

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

I know I am the best candidate to take on Joe Biden and the Democrats next year, but I want to hear from you. Are you planning on watching? Elevating healthy discourse and policy contrast with other candidates isn't an attack, but will be an opportunity to see who will actually stand up to Xi Jinping as well as the Deep State. This debate will be your first chance to see who is not afraid to lead this nation to become a better America and reclaim a country we can be proud of. | 1. Will you be tuning into the first GOP Primary debate on August 23rd? 2. Have you endorsed a candidate for President yet? 3. What question or topic do you want to see the candidates and myself debate? | The truth is, right now I am the only presidential candidate with a plan for the issues facing America today. From reviving our national identity to unleashing our economy and declaring economic independence from communist China, my vision is focused on national revival, not a national divorce. Together, we can take America First to the next level. Thanks, Vivek Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:**
August 23, 2023
Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com)
**Tell It Like It Is: Tonight’s Debate Was Vintage Chris Christie**
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Bill Palatucci, Chairman of Tell It Like It Is PAC, issued the following statement on tonight’s Republican presidential debate in Milwaukee:
“Tonight Republican voters witnessed a vintage performance by Chris Christie. He was direct, authentic, true-to-himself and told it like it is. Unlike some of the other candidates, he is offering a clear rationale for his candidacy: our party deserves better than Donald Trump and our country cannot afford Joe Biden. Having governed in the toughest of political terrain, Chris Christie has an unmatched record of success, from taking on the teachers’ unions to cutting taxes and cleaning up one of America’s most dangerous cities. There’s a reason the last two polls put the Governor in second place in New Hampshire. It would be a mistake to ever underestimate him.”
Below is a sampling of what others are saying about Chris Christie’s debate performance:

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

There are two genders. Human flourishing requires fossil fuels. Reverse racism is racism. An open border is no border. Parents determine the education of their children. The nuclear family is the greatest form of governance known to mankind. Capitalism lifts people up from poverty. There are three branches of the U.S. government, not four. The U.S. Constitution is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history. | My Republican opponents offered a lot of great points tonight but here's why my campaign is different: I'm going to revolutionize the way our government is run. The people who we elect to run the government are NOT the ones who actually run the government. It's the managerial class in the Deep State. You cannot reform these agencies. The only answer is to SHUT THEM DOWN , and I am the only presidential candidate who has the plan on how to actually do it. We have got to change the conversation. Stop talking about Biden & start talking about what we actually stand for as Republicans. Spouting off poll-tested platitudes about Biden makes us sound like partisan hacks. And that's exactly why it's going to take an outsider from a new generation to get the job done. I don't want a national divorce, and other candidates are pushing us toward the brink of that division. I'm running to lead us to a national revival. If we can revive that, then nobody in the world - not a nation, not a corporation, not a virus - will defeat us. Fellow American - are you ready for the revolution? America First, Vivek Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence**. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States. I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago – an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something – that we do love this country. I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Fellow Conservative, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race after this pivotal debate, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=87a7bf4f18224c8dac19e8ac123c43ec&_e=uhcI3oTqnmzFeKT5XBorFH6N5xZGhLr8LrabpDPi-uFDzt1kQ6W51YfwjsUuBhx-24NUqBmStSgjt-4JEF44lzqi6IPs8AzzZhAonLNw01toSHB4v6Ug1soogWBTl_dRV6iIv3zta06MGFWPhggvTx1naQ2aeW31S_TJg2AAqkF5Ok2FK6A4eqsHoaBrFHcOmBub5D0QHDyzrmqcxUHaz_W-CafCfRMcIpuopM6tloPUWinNKTQ8IqZSiZBoATndkrNa4KAFFzVMijlqU2HZvnKyC1JBNiCYVwQgPe1fTSePtLtIfFB9kOn221Oa8yVhRsz0ahCZwvtBinpYlML0EbS3wD7vZnadoPsdKJaIkVHqqX33QeQK_wtYH_UBr1SHdflysJjFx9-hUMk91kJ-0KaX2N0eM6NpwHB2hC_0n1g%3D)

Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Peter,

The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country.

If you’re just tuning into the race after this pivotal debate, I’d like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I’m running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I’m asking for your support.

Here’s my story: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation’s freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=080d0431823234e22a188a75588e9b0206f8105d5b263f4438da688af77b4f57d3f1faf6d9f5e106691fe20a3c533da33995438026a53ad1164834e17b96241e

Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=080d0431823234e22a188a75588e9b0206f8105d5b263f4438da688af77b4f57d3f1faf6d9f5e106691fe20a3c533da33995438026a53ad1164834e17b96241e

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That’s why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans.

Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:

-

Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;

-

Ranks number one for new business formations;

-

Ranks number one for net in-migration;

-

Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;

-

Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;

-

Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;

-

Has NO state income tax;

-

Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=080d0431823234e22a188a75588e9b0206f8105d5b263f4438da688af77b4f57d3f1faf6d9f5e106691fe20a3c533da33995438026a53ad1164834e17b96241e

But here’s the problem, Peter.

Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They’re telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay.

Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation’s oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline.

We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob.

These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. This election is not about me. It’s about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob’s fraud.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=080d0431823234e22a188a75588e9b0206f8105d5b263f4438da688af77b4f57d3f1faf6d9f5e106691fe20a3c533da33995438026a53ad1164834e17b96241e

Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline.

That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I’m not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country.

The time to act is NOW.

I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I am fighting to earn your support and lead when it matters most. Starting on Day One as President of the United States, these are just some of the plans I am promising to you:

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=080d0431823234e22a188a75588e9b0206f8105d5b263f4438da688af77b4f57d3f1faf6d9f5e106691fe20a3c533da33995438026a53ad1164834e17b96241e

Ron DeSantis

Meet Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=080d0431823234e22a188a75588e9b0206f8105d5b263f4438da688af77b4f57d3f1faf6d9f5e106691fe20a3c533da33995438026a53ad1164834e17b96241e

A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom – even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
-
Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,
-
Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,
-
Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,
-
Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,
-
Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,
-
Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,
-
Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,
-
Protecting the unborn,
-
Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,
-
Expanding education freedom,
-
Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,
-
Lowering prescription drug costs,
-
Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,
-
Creating a universal school choice program,
-
Delivering record-breaking tax relief,
-
Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,
-
Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,
-
Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,
-
Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,
-
...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn’t stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican – as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: “When the world lost its mind – when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue – Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism.”

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor’s leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration’s overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor’s vision, this year’s legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida’s history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
-
Record tax relief
-
ESG prohibitions
-
Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP
-
The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.
-
Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency
-
Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI
-
Improvements to our state’s infrastructure
-
Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists
-
The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis
-
Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions
-
Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida
No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom – even when it wasn’t popular. Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: - Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, - Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, - Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, - Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, - Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, - Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, - Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, - Protecting the unborn, - Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, - Expanding education freedom, - Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, - Lowering prescription drug costs, - Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, - Creating a universal school choice program, - Delivering record-breaking tax relief, - Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, - Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, - Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, - Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, - ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn’t stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican – as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: “When the world lost its mind – when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue – Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism.” Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor’s leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration’s overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor’s vision, this year’s legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida’s history. This year, Governor DeSantis signed: - Record tax relief - ESG prohibitions - Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP - The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation. - Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency - Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI - Improvements to our state’s infrastructure - Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists - The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis - Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions - Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback. Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason. subject: Peter, badass young people have a habit of being underestimated...
body:
This is the biggest thing I’ve ever been a part of.

| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta5b0fb91-1e9b-45bb-9e31-9acfb01e38f4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | Hey, Peter, it’s David Hogg, gun safety advocate and co-founder of March For Our Lives. The GOP and conservative special interest groups have been playing a 50-year chess game to elect far-right extremists to every level of government to manipulate our country and attack our rights and freedoms. They are willing to let children be slaughtered at school and watch our planet burn for personal gain. But badass young people have a habit of being underestimated, from March For Our Lives to the Sunrise Movement to the Movement for Black Lives. And when we demonstrate our collective power, we scare the shit out of Republicans. That’s why with an incredible team, we launched Leaders We Deserve — a grassroots organization dedicated to electing young leaders to Congress, and especially our State Legislatures, across the country to help defeat the far-right’s agenda and advance a progressive vision for the future. [We can’t do this without you by our side. Will you become a Founding Donor by splitting a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td80d4be3-2855-4cf7-9190-c9b37520ffe6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | I’ll be blunt: There is no shortage of people who want us to fail. And unless we band together and fight back, nothing is going to change. It’s part of why despite making up 45% of the electorate, Gen Z and Millennials only hold 21% of State Legislature seats. Special interest groups, far-right extremists, and those hoarding the power are so determined to maintain the status quo that they will spend millions to keep Gen Z candidates from winning. They think that they can continue to manipulate the system to keep us out of elected office. Let’s prove them wrong, Peter. [That’s why I’m personally asking: Will you become a Founding Donor to Leaders We Deserve by splitting a donation with Blue Amp Action today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T33f9fda4-3a39-482f-a38a-350b29d634e6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Let’s do this, David Hogg Co-founder, Leaders We Deserve

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Friend – As our first tv ad of the election begins airing this morning, I wanted to make sure you were one of the first to see it. **[WATCH HERE](http://sendpatriot.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/351b1b1c9b54fe71/b5c3fb37fe95bdafc3d6b838967d376c/37923)**

It is an absolute honor to work alongside Governor Youngkin to deliver results for our community. During my first term we cut the gas tax, created good paying jobs, and cut taxes on veteran’s pensions. I’m focused on the issue that matters most to Virginia Beach families: cost of living. While the General Assembly can’t directly address inflation, we can continue to cut your costs and make sure that more of your money stays in your pocket. Holding the majority in the House of Delegates runs right through the 97th District. Make your plan to vote early, volunteer, and if your financial situation allows, [donate](http://sendpatriot.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/351b1b1c9b54fe71/e6d1a1dc8106d30fc3d6b838967d376c/37923) to help me get over the finish line. We are just getting started! Karen

## GOP Candidates Battle as 80 Million Watch Trump
Republican candidates faced off Wednesday night, and there were plenty of fireworks during the [broad, free-wheeling discussion](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uwyAUQOGngS0Wvpc_DwxdvKVrR4vAJabCJrKRad--aufOR2f4Pu7L3eeS9-e738i1VBcfWr5oEfYG8ga4AI8uEQEhJzfqCazROCFf3fQIIEOQepQPTaR0ChYhjohaeUuCZwcCUFiQYkKj5DD6aI2KIUaTjFHIpKCYWz2Gz5r3tlIq3_WiYwh148Wtrb1Ohm8MZgZz731I9Wunfv52BjM_XHz1XEo-tWFSPDefy9_b_qf8BAAA___gm0n2) that moderators struggled to control. Foreign policy, abortion, and climate change sparked most of the exchanges--along with attacks on political newcomer Vivek Ramaswamy, who has surged lately in national polls, over his experience level. Six of the eight candidates raised their hands showing they'd support Trump if he was the nominee; only Chris Christie and Asa Hutchinson didn't and were booed. Trump was absent, choosing instead to post an interview with Tucker Carlson ([Watch here)](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGngS0R3GGDB4aqkrd0qtTRwnDEtNhE9iVR375Su3b-h1_fx2W6hFLLdn0LK3nObQqRy4Mm5U5gToATyOQzERBK8rofwNkeB5SLT9blOSI5JOuCyi7YnHBQZp4xuZhk8aAAlQOjBrSdOeuQnO1STMlmazsURlEq3PbzZysbL5Trd3vQfo5tldUvzLdD4IuAUcDIz8L81wSM7_f4Rftr2OvRNgHjwYHvh4BR94PpNPYKodNgtDYod59uz1JrOXorjLquodTfB_9P_gkAAP__xP1WJw) to compete with the debate. The interview racked up over 80 million views on X, formerly Twitter, by the time the debate ended.

The night ended without a consensus winner, but Ramaswamy, Pence, and DeSantis are the subject of [many strong opinions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdEZmxthQuHgN3b42JTL2sEzixQictfbvo02d7hZXOkfn4zbfPCfe7__9g1xZ8-xD4SfNapCgJeAMTXQrERA25DozwmANjthsblmsVYsJvR7RGDTWookj6Nj3KqIaGnagANUAWo1oe912Pg62jyFGu1rbo9CKIpd8tp-Z97LRml75SWcb8qNJbivluAT-EzAJmGqt7ZETFw75fRAw7VQvAdObImBSw3trAdNJx_eSOPhdRlp8IVm3LGveZfFf5Kt_XVKprgMzds3p4lE5Jb6MFVrdH57Tr0D5u8dPAAAA__-r9F6e) about the debate's biggest winners and losers.

Which candidate do you think had the best night? Cast your vote in our poll (toward the bottom of today's edition) and we'll publish the results tomorrow.
## Russian Coup Leader Reported Dead in Crash
Yevgeny Prigozhin, who led a coup attempt against Russian President Putin in late June, [was killed Wednesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGngS0W3GEOBoYu3tK1o0XMkVARE9nIVt--SufOn_RL_9d1vsZSy3r_jE8OPbc5Lr0cPCt3AXMBnEGmkJmBUXLQ1oMjix7lI2idHULSWhNGa5BGrTl6RGchJ7CyBFCAyoFRHmk0g47J0ZiWlCgTjSiM4lR624bvVtb-4Fx_2sHbsLSnrOHR-2sX-CFgEjCd5zncbsvbBEwrn7uAqZaD39a2mi7Wjt4TGbmF9DpLrWW3JIy6P2Opf83-_-JvAAAA__8ywU_N) when his private jet crashed en route to St. Petersburg from Moscow, according to Russian officials. The plane's crash was caught on video ([watch here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvhSAURn-NbtfgBUUGhy5ur2tHQ-GqvIdggGjsr29e587fd5KT8_WYH9p5F9ZPvdNYljhrU9xJMxsABSCfsbbjQoTEaxrbXuEge654vY2WS6O1aBW3GpXuqVekTKcGIb_5gLZ2IzLkbEDBFJedaFptB9lZY61cpOx4JRhZV2JqntGFstHi73hSakzcaz9upRy54h8VThVOga7c5Nf9HiucconprnAqFODlvCcLLsCR3KkLwZMKmKTzBiGmskFcYI_ZxAsuvQZK4ElbSnDTuVK439wafzYXIAY4dM4U1vfL5QItKtEz1tdptMflvHe5l5Vg666d_1Mt_5f7DQAA___czHKm)). Early reports couldn't confirm if Prigozhin was aboard the plane, but Russia's aviation authority confirmed that he was. Western officials are openly skeptical that the crash was an accident, given Putin's reputation. They're also reserving judgment on[ whether Prigozhin really was on the jet.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFzhCAUBOBfox0OAoIUFGmuu7QpHY730Jdw4ghzxvz6jKnT7lfs7H7cp7unROv87p_oasyTD5VeOPGRCcWEnEQLLiIKlC26XlsxGi2tbBcXrRgeKuhBa2l7_whWazsoGSwgKBhbcoILyUehuJVmUF3vYTQDBAATjRlkozgC1bx3n5nWumBMZ37h3oX8bJNbat1KI98acWvE7TiOLubvFY9y-ZXkPUEjbie-ZlxPtu0055-FVrYlvyILuy8LAvuidE1kPWc5RgrkU2HFn-3uYDsuLNo0is9PT-mvu_5_xW8AAAD___BEYfU)

body:
Our path to victory is clear from the first debate. Now I'd like to make sure you know what I'm fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=20081004115e4ebe8e5990fc1f4ba9f6&_e=9mLeM5LZEi3t4XmoJ96fB6GnCcZk3mLIpCzeIJX7711tXvF92K_O67FbNDbD1bcvLPlUfWXTxqDUr7GBDIQRm1Sm63VBiO8n-iOhPTcxo8nfUCZL_3bCDDLNfluMdrcUa48y8d-QVvX18SSi4qoQL7lk8LJgKMz4iYHY7Iwy0A4QQBgaJeHiIfLnD51kbNUwcP4sVi-l3J0Uk7oNJwnRl4BqhOYOY7EQbCxUnN-QRNNlq-01U3SYm2V3RVeFvTrlgFpzpUotHKn8xr8Bu52ODZw2rylbwknkOK_SlTrlkEtBnv_eLBBs94q5ORK1CifWPrbRWtYZPtRJ7WbwAvFrBmDuCIfei4FAi6f5gSfLD9j3RYRozdJ_Y72fFvEAinqctiWTe6UdJV2hga6GORoDGEnob7V_02-3bKzwB5jM-Q0%3D)
---
Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race after this pivotal debate, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=20081004115e4ebe8e5990fc1f4ba9f6&_e=9mLeM5LZEi3t4XmoJ96fB6GnCcZk3mLIpCzeIJX7711tXvF92K_O67FbNDbD1bcvLPlUfWXTxqDUr7GBDIQRm1Sm63VBiO8n-iOhPTcxo8nfUCZL_3bCDDLNfluMdrcUa48y8d-QVvX18SSi4qoQL7lk8LJgKMz4iYHY7Iwy0A4QQBgaJeHiIfLnD51kbNUwcP4sVi-l3J0Uk7oNJwnRl4BqhOYOY7EQbCxUnN-QRNNlq-01U3SYm2V3RVeFvTrlgFpzpUotHKn8xr8Bu52ODXU4og8XtXn0BfgBEUmuhQSE98cKthBik0CtcdvdTv11MhVXNPklVgOddxyIyARoLF8TQmz6HWZGisFelSjiDD8tT90GTX9IzEK9CGMZb3NOaxNWR638vKhYfpCcsS-Xiwu-0U5hSaSX4fQFWg7jmLk%3D)
---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=20081004115e4ebe8e5990fc1f4ba9f6&_e=9mLeM5LZEi3t4XmoJ96fB6GnCcZk3mLIpCzeIJX7711tXvF92K_O67FbNDbD1bcvLPlUfWXTxqDUr7GBDIQRm1Sm63VBiO8n-iOhPTcxo8nfUCZL_3bCDDLNfluMdrcUa48y8d-QVvX18SSi4qoQL7lk8LJgKMz4iYHY7Iwy0A4QQBgaJeHiIfLnD51kbNUwcP4sVi-l3J0Uk7oNJwnRl4BqhOYOY7EQbCxUnN-QRNNlq-01U3SYm2V3RVeFvTrlgFpzpUotHKn8xr8Bu52ODTK7zecj8cTNPmDe3w5YEc1FtcetAvKubbFd53KBxHA-7RiNmFdrQHTA6HAevUxVDnXHoXj70bJPsjUlGAazwClvCPOIsZfmzoW9BmW6_VYh9RY47Q7wVJ2J2bwnNSQgNdq_Rfp_QN4RZ_PMnss8Ijc%3D)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

subject: Your Signature is Needed: Protect innocent animals on factory farms
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1944726?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Animals are enduring UNIMAGINABLE CRUELTY at factory farms right now!** **It could get even worse without your help! >>** **[Take action now! ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1944727?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Picture this: mama pigs shoved into crates so small they _**can’t even turn around!**_ Hens confined to cages too that _**don’t allow them to spread their wings!**_ Some of these animals will never feel the sun or the freedom of an open pasture before they’re _**mercilessly slaughtered.**_ The good news is that many states have animal welfare laws preventing factory farms from committing some of the most abusive practices. **But a bill in Congress could REVERSE HUNDREDS of state laws, including these protections for animals.** [**Please, Friend, take just 30 seconds to tell Congress to oppose the EATS Act and SAVE innocent animals from inhumane treatment! Add your name by 11:59pm TONIGHT!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1944728?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1944729?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
The filthy, cramped conditions in these industrial operations are **prime breeding grounds for bacteria and disease.** And the diseases won’t just affect animals – they can spread to people too. In fact, some scientists predict this could be the _**source of the next pandemic!**_
We can’t allow Republicans in Congress to repeal the few anti-animal cruelty laws for farm animals that exist. But this is a _**DANGEROUSLY REAL**_ possibility – and **that’s why we need your help!** [**Tell Congress: OPPOSE the EATS Act and keep animal welfare laws intact! >> **](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1944730?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

**Standing with you,
Chloë Waterman
Climate-friendly food senior program manager,
Friends of the Earth**

name: Nikki Haley
subject: The American Dream
body:
we’re continuing to build a SURGE of momentum

| |
---
| | |
---
| | | Friend, can I share something important with you?

Over the last six months we’ve held more than 100 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **FIRST** debate, and we’re continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.

**BUT** , we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

_**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for president and why your support matters.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21394%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=txrO5eO2D7VtEq0S3QVE%2fA&sysid=1 "As we continue to build a
winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for president and why your
support matters.")**_

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21305%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=t8Ny1wYDw4qf5rAMdb1dKA&sysid=1)
---

I’m a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can’t afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and _a national debt over 32 trillion dollars._

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for president to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

_**[But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21306%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=waGW68LhyjOXebwvxfoGhA&sysid=1 "But, I need your help to
make it happen. Can I count on you? ")**_

I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for.

As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me.

As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people’s deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it.

As Governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace.

And as Ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard.

Our moment is now - and our mission is clear.

_**[Will you help me save our country and secure our future?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21307%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wEc2%2fnOtlfBuTiSW%2fGyHew&sysid=1 "Will you help me save our
country and secure our future?")**_

---
| | [SECURE OUR FUTURE](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21308%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Cot3%2fh1l2zMzAb6ZfVdj6w&sysid=1)
---

**[I appreciate your support more than you can imagine. If you can join me today by chipping in, it would mean so much to me.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21309%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=OouzXEjzKN5PTanJDv%2ftsA&sysid=1 "I appreciate your support
more than you can imagine. If you can join me today by chipping in, it would mean
so much to me.")**

Thank you for everything you do for our country.

My very best,
Nikki R. Haley

This is going to be another great year of learning and friendship! | | YOU WRITE THE BILL WORKSHOP - SEPT. 14 Join us Thursday September 14th, 5:30 pm, at the Melrose Branch Library Community Room, for our annual "You Write the Bill Workshop". You'll be able to learn about how a bill becomes law here in the Commonwealth, as well as work with others that share your passion to draft bills. All are welcome! Please share with anyone you think may be interested. | == | == | | | CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT | | | | == | == | == Senator Monty Mason is a trusted leader with a proven track record of success. He has served in the Virginia Legislature since 2013, where he has been a tireless advocate for the people of his district. Prior to his election, Monty worked at VISA as a Senior Director of Fraud Prevention and Risk Management. His professional experience has given him a deep understanding of the unique challenges facing Virginia and the skills necessary to address them. A proud Virginian, Senator Mason lives in Williamsburg with his wife and two daughters. For the past decade, Monty Mason's professional leadership has delivered real results for our district's families, businesses, and schools. He knows how to get things done at the state level and will keep fighting for our community. | | | REGIONAL CANDIDATE EVENTS | | | | | == Canvass for Sam & Trish! Join us Saturday to canvass for Sam and Trish! Meet our Field Coordinator, Dom, on August 26th at the Williamson Road Library, 12:30pm. Located at 3837 Williamson Rd, Roanoke, VA 24012. | | | == Canvass for Lily Franklin! On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event! Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. ICF homes are more energy efficient, weather resistant, and keep more pollutants out than traditional homes. | == | == Northwest Ace Roanoke Wing Fest - Aug. 26 This Saturday, August 26th, is the 14th annual Northwest Ace Roanoke Wing Fest, featuring live music, tons of wing vendors, cornhole, contests, and more throughout the day! Tickets are $5 in advance or $7 at the gate. Kids 12 and under are free. Guest parking is at the garage located at 6 Riverside Circle. Pre-registration is required as space is limited. name: Vivek Ramaswamy
subject: What a night!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vivek 2024
body:
Did you see the debate?

| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675537%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6h9WAcgOaPtyQxTmdQWi8w&sysid=1)
Fellow American,

When I stepped off the stage, I could feel electricity in the air. _This campaign has built tremendous momentum and we aren't letting up for a minute._

For those of you who have been with me since the beginning, you know how big tonight's victory is. We started this campaign back in late February polling at 0.0%. My vision is for an America more unified by our founding ideals than torn apart by our perceived differences.

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675538%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=g78Hj4amdn73Gh8RGWpODw&sysid=1)
---

My Republican opponents offered a lot of great points tonight but here's why my campaign is different:
* I'm going to revolutionize the way our government is run. _The people who we elect to run the government are NOT the ones who actually run the government_. It's the managerial class in the Deep State. You cannot reform these agencies. The only answer is to **SHUT THEM DOWN** , and I am the only presidential candidate who has the plan on how to actually do it.
* We have got to change the conversation. Stop talking about Biden & start talking about what we actually stand for as Republicans. Spouting off poll-tested platitudes about Biden makes us sound like partisan hacks. And that's exactly why it's going to take an outsider from a new generation to get the job done.
* I don't want a national divorce, and other candidates are pushing us toward the brink of that division. I'm running to lead us to a national revival. If we can revive that, then nobody in the world - not a nation, not a corporation, not a virus - will defeat us.

**[Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 20 weeks until the first primary election. Chip in $20 today and together, let's make America our first priority.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675539%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BR9RppKtbCoUKiTh1UYDcQ&sysid=1)**

_Fellow American - are you ready for the revolution?_

America First,

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675537%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6h9WAcgOaPtyQxTmdQWi8w&sysid=1)
Vivek Ramaswamy

[** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT →**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675530%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UrHdfNVGxPawcxKeKCacwA&sysid=1)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[ ** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675531%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9rEici8I6XzdGIRXYVjnAA&sysid=1)

body:
