The first Republican presidential primary debate marked just the
beginning. We fought, and we will continue to fight. We will
never back down.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osURGw4D2N

Friend,

I
took the stage last night to face the nation and show the country
what an energetic executive vision for our future looks like.

We
are now one step closer to winning this primary, defeating Joe
Biden, restoring sanity to our nation, fighting for American
freedom, defending parental and family rights, rebuilding our
economy, ending the invasion at our border, and saving this
country from the disastrous policies of our current failing
leaders.

I
stood on that stage last night to be your voice and your fighter,
and I hope I made you proud. I will never back down from standing
up for what YOU need.

I
participated in the first Republican primary debate last night to
make sure that you know that when elected I will be the kind of
leader who will reverse this nation's decline and achieve our
Great American Comeback. If you're with me in the fight that I
laid out at the debate, I'm asking for your support to help me
fight back.

<<
Help me continue to fight back by rushing in any amount you can
to my campaign here >>

Now
that this first debate is over, it will take ALL OF US to hold
the line. I need your support, Friend, and I am counting on you.
NOW is the time America needs us to step up and change course.

Step up. Save America with me.

⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️

Rush in $25

Rush in $50

Rush in $75

Rush in $100

I
can't do this alone. That debate was a huge opportunity for our
team and we can NOT let it go to waste. By coming together, we
are ditching the Republican culture of losing and the first
debate was only the beginning.

In
Freedom,

Ron
DeSantis

Meet Ron DeSantis

A native Floridian with
blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a
nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin
High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he
was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated
with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission
in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service,
Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah,
Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military
decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service
and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron
also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child
predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a
platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits
and a balanced budget amendment.

In
Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the
weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to
hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in
manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a
veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our
country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans
and expand support for mental health.

In
2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As
governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for
the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when
the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media
united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis
stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding
principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to
transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival.
Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative
priorities:

Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine
mandates,

Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border
crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against
illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured
professors accountable,

Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital
currency,

Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

Protecting the unborn,

Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a
constitutional carry state,

Expanding education freedom,

Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and
entities,

Lowering prescription drug costs,

Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

Creating a universal school choice program,

Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme
Court,

...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout
his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of
nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the
largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than
1.5 million votes.

But
history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the
majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional
wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently
as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30
points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red,
including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties
overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor
DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics,
and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with
battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing
down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his
inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense
suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of
sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even
for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we
choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than
cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe
place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership,
Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education
opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden
Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that
seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to
the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered
the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's
history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:

Record tax relief

ESG prohibitions

Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering
transparency

Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

Improvements to our state's infrastructure

Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death
penalty for child rapists

The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border
crisis

Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward
school unions

Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No
leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor
DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country,
leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron
is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television

In Freedom, Ron DeSantis Meet Ron DeSantis A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment. In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. body:
In one week, we close the books on our August fundraising deadline. Our last one before our official FEC deadline.
#

Peter -
In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. Please give me a chance to explain why this request, especially today, is so critically important.
Here is the absolute truth:
In one week, we close the books on our August fundraising deadline. Our last one before our official FEC deadline.
And right now we're short of our fundraising goals. By a decent amount.
I don't know if it's because I've taken some time off from fundraising after my daughter was born.
I don't know if it's because people think we have some kind of fundraising advantage because we out-raised Senator Sinema for two quarters. When the truth is she has a huge cash-on-hand advantage.
But we have seven days to make up this gap, and there's no gang of hedge fund managers coming to drop pallets of cash from a helicopter on us.
It's going to take lots and lots of people donating. So please: give $3 to help us replace Kyrsten Sinema with a vote for the issues you care about.
$3 to help keep Kari Lake out of the Senate.
$3 today because time is running out to reach our August goals.
[**Can I count on you to help us close the fundraising gap with a $3 contribution to our campaign today? I really need lots and lots of people who understand how important this race and this moment is to chip in.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-aug23.NWxa9e&refcode=em230824-1-f&t=1&akid=1010%2E734936%2EL7zB_d)

body:
Our path to victory is clear from the first debate. Now I’d like to make sure you know what I’m fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21313%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aw%2f9Tl6o2hYLpAQH1hfCsQ&sysid=1)
---
Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you’re just tuning into the race after this pivotal debate, I’d like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I’m running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I’m asking for your support.** _**Here’s my story**_ : I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation’s freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21313%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aw%2f9Tl6o2hYLpAQH1hfCsQ&sysid=1)
---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21313%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aw%2f9Tl6o2hYLpAQH1hfCsQ&sysid=1)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That’s why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21313%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aw%2f9Tl6o2hYLpAQH1hfCsQ&sysid=1)
---
But here’s the problem, Friend. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They’re telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation’s oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. It’s about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob’s fraud.**_
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21313%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aw%2f9Tl6o2hYLpAQH1hfCsQ&sysid=1)
---
Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline. That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I’m not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. The time to act is NOW.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21313%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aw%2f9Tl6o2hYLpAQH1hfCsQ&sysid=1)
---
| | [Chip in to my campaign here](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21314%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VKjprzPReaS7xzHNIUGKnQ&sysid=1)
---
I believe that decline is choice, success is attainable, and freedom is worth fighting for. I fought with everything I had on that debate stage on August 23rd and took my vision for restoring this nation directly to the American people. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I am fighting to earn your support and lead when it matters most. Starting on Day One as President of the United States, these are just some of the plans I am promising to you:
---

---
Friend, together, we will restore sanity to our society, normalcy to our communities, and integrity to our institutions.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21313%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aw%2f9Tl6o2hYLpAQH1hfCsQ&sysid=1)
---
I stood up for the needs of the American people on the debate stage, and I made sure you know that I will never back down from being your voice and your fighter. _**[Please, join me in fighting for the future--because freedom is always worth fighting for.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21325%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AVrH5oxGQLzQ5rZBIP2%2bzA&sysid=1 "Please, join me in
fighting for the future—because freedom is always worth fighting for.")**_ In Freedom,
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21313%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aw%2f9Tl6o2hYLpAQH1hfCsQ&sysid=1)
---
Ron DeSantis

---
|

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21326%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ypqMRv73DEfHx%2bNtnxpKog&sysid=1)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn’t stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: “When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism.”

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor’s leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration’s overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor’s vision, this year’s legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida’s history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state’s infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Suzanne Crouch will Eliminate Indiana’s Individual Income Tax when elected Indiana Governor
Conservative candidate for governor will lead the fight to “Axe the Tax”, reform government, and help Hoosiers offset the costs of Bidenomics.
EVANSVILLE, IN—Lieutenant Governor and Republican gubernatorial candidate Suzanne Crouch announced today that she wants to eliminate Indiana’s individual income tax.
https://crouchforindiana.com/axe-the-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ad8a5fb85c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_22_06_04_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-48fcf30bad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Due to the unwavering fiscal conservatism enforced by Republican governors for the past three decades, Indiana has a budget reserve of nearly three billion dollars.

Additionally, and because of President Joe Biden’s dismal and destructive economic policies, Hoosiers have less money in their pockets, but are also spending significantly more for groceries, energy, and everyday living expenses.

“Hoosiers know best how to spend their hard-earned money,” said Crouch. “As governor, I will ‘Axe the Tax’ and put thousands of dollars back into the pockets of working Hoosiers while also updating our tax code to reflect the 21^st century.”

“It’s not the government’s money,” continued Crouch. “It’s your money, and as governor, I will make sure you keep more of it.”

Lt. Gov. Crouch’s bold tax reduction program will eliminate the individual income tax while also building in safeguards against an economic downturn. It will maintain a healthy surplus, empower small businesses, make Indiana even more competitive for jobs and economic talent, and create a task force to find efficiencies and cost savings in state government.

As a result of her plan, Hoosiers will save thousands of dollars.

According to the Tax Foundation’s 2023 State Business Tax Climate Index (https://taxfoundation.org/research/all/state/2023-state-business-tax-climate-index/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ad8a5fb85c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_22_06_04_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-48fcf30bad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , Indiana ranks ninth overall, but seven of the eight states ahead of it in the rankings either have no individual income tax or sales tax.

“The state legislature is doing important work on Indiana’s tax system,” said Crouch. “By working with public and private sector leaders as your governor, we will accelerate the process to ‘Axe the Tax’ in my first term.”

If you want to join the fight to axe the tax, sign the petition at axethetaxindiana.com (http://axethetaxindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ad8a5fb85c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_22_06_04_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-48fcf30bad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

To learn more about how Suzanne wants to eliminate your individual income tax, please visit her website at www.crouchforindiana.com.

Fellow American: Today Trump will be arrested in Georgia for doing nothing but defending our country and asking legitimate questions. We need your help to go door to door in order to talk to voters who have become disengaged and disenfranchised. Voters are giving up on the political apparatus. name: Vivek Ramaswamy
subject: What a night!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vivek 2024
body:
Did you see the debate?

| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4n682ad3f03m1bpohdcji3d6vv4p0s8i4to30fg_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)
Fellow American,

When I stepped off the stage, I could feel electricity in the air. _This campaign has built tremendous momentum and we aren't letting up for a minute._

For those of you who have been with me since the beginning, you know how big tonight's victory is. We started this campaign back in late February polling at 0.0%. My vision is for an America more unified by our founding ideals than torn apart by our perceived differences.

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf4ukib43aplkaaefs8ai8pvg53dn4ddfn392f58_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)
---

My Republican opponents offered a lot of great points tonight but here's why my campaign is different:
* I'm going to revolutionize the way our government is run. _The people who we elect to run the government are NOT the ones who actually run the government_. It's the managerial class in the Deep State. You cannot reform these agencies. The only answer is to **SHUT THEM DOWN** , and I am the only presidential candidate who has the plan on how to actually do it.
* We have got to change the conversation. Stop talking about Biden & start talking about what we actually stand for as Republicans. Spouting off poll-tested platitudes about Biden makes us sound like partisan hacks. And that's exactly why it's going to take an outsider from a new generation to get the job done.
* I don't want a national divorce, and other candidates are pushing us toward the brink of that division. I'm running to lead us to a national revival. If we can revive that, then nobody in the world - not a nation, not a corporation, not a virus - will defeat us.

**[Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 20 weeks until the first primary election. Chip in $20 today and together, let's make America our first priority.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsuggokql30cdjo116on1c8pg4vgdk7vc7abtnoo_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)**

_Fellow American - are you ready for the revolution?_

America First,

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zivm4okjsr09v4v2fmu1iq8d8uh0pirq0k3adj0g_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

[** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT ->**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo7tbsbeatp3h9amq8nphi42nltkijrv2483bro8_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq9nd597m8gmumqv6bcnq5lt6peek0j90pd4s00o_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)

| | Hi Peter, it’s Stacey Abrams and I wanted to share a quick message with you ahead of the 2024 election. [_**If you’re already with us — and you know how important Georgia will be next November — please, rush a donation right now to the Democratic Party of Georgia.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68570653/423481942/710125701?refcode=20230824.1_SA_8AL&amount=20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZTM0OGI1ZC04MDQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=18M4QyZtZGGgr_sAyYa2hPpPc2bbboDPQbqNKWrrPJ4=)**_

Here’s one thing we know for certain: if the GOP loses Georgia in 2024, then they lose the White House. And we need to make sure that happens because the GOP’s extreme agenda has been and will continue to be devastating for people in Georgia and across the country.

The Republican party has spent every waking minute working to rip away our fundamental rights and the support that millions of Americans rely on every day.

They’ve banned abortion rights in states across the country, attacked transgender children, politicized public school education, and taken food off the table for families that rely on SNAP benefits.

**And they won’t stop there. If Donald Trump or any of the other extreme Republican candidates defeats Joe Biden for the presidency, they can further curtail voting rights, enact a national abortion ban, and install extreme right-wing judges in critical positions in our judicial system.**

**_But we can stop them right here in Georgia._**

If the GOP loses Georgia, then they lose the White House.

We proved it in 2020 when we elected Joe Biden and Kamala Harris and defeated Donald Trump, and we all know that Georgia’s 16 electoral college votes could be the deciding votes again in 2024. Everyone from the election experts at _FiveThirtyEight_ to Donald Trump himself knows that Georgia will be the key to the White House next year.

[_**So I’m asking – will you rush a donation right now to the Democratic Party of Georgia so we can stop Trump and his allies right here, right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68570654/423481943/710125701?refcode=20230824.1_SA_8AL&amount=20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZTM0OGI1ZC04MDQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=18M4QyZtZGGgr_sAyYa2hPpPc2bbboDPQbqNKWrrPJ4=)**_

If we win in Georgia, we’ll keep the GOP out of the White House and protect the future of our state and the entire country.

\- Stacey

clean_body: | | | Hi Peter, it’s Stacey Abrams and I wanted to share a quick message with you ahead of the 2024 election. = Here’s one thing we know for certain: if the GOP loses Georgia in 2024, then they lose the White House. And we need to make sure that happens because the GOP’s extreme agenda has been and will continue to be devastating for people in Georgia and across the country. The Republican party has spent every waking minute working to rip away our fundamental rights and the support that millions of Americans rely on every day. They’ve banned abortion rights in states across the country, attacked transgender children, politicized public school education, and taken food off the table for families that rely on SNAP benefits. And they won’t stop there. If Donald Trump or any of the other extreme Republican candidates defeats Joe Biden for the presidency, they can further curtail voting rights, enact a national abortion ban, and install extreme right-wing judges in critical positions in our judicial system. But we can stop them right here in Georgia. If the GOP loses Georgia, then they lose the White House. We proved it in 2020 when we elected Joe Biden and Kamala Harris and defeated Donald Trump, and we all know that Georgia’s 16 electoral college votes could be the deciding votes again in 2024. Everyone from the election experts at FiveThirtyEight to Donald Trump himself knows that Georgia will be the key to the White House next year. =_ If we win in Georgia, we’ll keep the GOP out of the White House and protect the future of our state and the entire country. \- Stacey | | Paid for by the Democratic Party of Georgia. body:
Did you see the debate?

| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ze9l9fml9ko1r65jf9ocvj4uma8cd0ugk8gpk8m0_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)
Fellow American,

When I stepped off the stage, I could feel electricity in the air. _This campaign has built tremendous momentum and we aren't letting up for a minute._

For those of you who have been with me since the beginning, you know how big tonight's victory is. We started this campaign back in late February polling at 0.0%. My vision is for an America more unified by our founding ideals than torn apart by our perceived differences.

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z47pi4jfgjo6etq1ct2rqbslvl8ju9c3f934u6h0_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)
---

My Republican opponents offered a lot of great points tonight but here's why my campaign is different:
* I'm going to revolutionize the way our government is run. _The people who we elect to run the government are NOT the ones who actually run the government_. It's the managerial class in the Deep State. You cannot reform these agencies. The only answer is to **SHUT THEM DOWN** , and I am the only presidential candidate who has the plan on how to actually do it.
* We have got to change the conversation. Stop talking about Biden & start talking about what we actually stand for as Republicans. Spouting off poll-tested platitudes about Biden makes us sound like partisan hacks. And that's exactly why it's going to take an outsider from a new generation to get the job done.
* I don't want a national divorce, and other candidates are pushing us toward the brink of that division. I'm running to lead us to a national revival. If we can revive that, then nobody in the world - not a nation, not a corporation, not a virus - will defeat us.

**[Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 20 weeks until the first primary election. Chip in $20 today and together, let's make America our first priority.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z4ruqsr2v139k9tjofj6hlnp13v33ua12casfpo0_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)**

_Fellow American - are you ready for the revolution?_

America First,

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zu4v7g2ehsf87vunecgjk6tvd9r0nikb8uu9d5ug_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

[** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT ->**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2l8iupbi92b5s0c7ufti69ags0n56u5mqt1allg_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3ieepj6clh2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Peter, I know firsthand better than most: **freedom isn** ’**t free.**

Escaping from Communist Vietnam as a child, I saw the price of having our freedom stripped away.

And serving the greatest country on Earth for 25 years in the Navy, I saw the sacrifices our troops made to make sure we _never_ go down the dark paths of Vietnam, China, and Venezuela.

**When I see Joe Biden and the Left disintegrate the freedoms I fought for, I** ’**m sick to my stomach - and you should be too.**
We can’t take our freedoms for granted. That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate, and that’s why I’m reaching out to you today.

[Will you join our fight for freedom today?](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=263c117225da4d9cb70671c170df2a65&_e=nKow3oBjgglTCwlGCv40pelX3XJBgfgxwKpxrPMyHZr6mPlDqsyswWnQBxb1_SaYIDAUmEeZf2r8EsI1cBAOflLyLDD2FQeW9rtYJxqXNPFQDcLKSVOSR9POmdc_XOvZIXxXVds0rgPJWCMGJMn028EhZHr6JpY6fcfOlw9THh2dB7ga8pcznpjnRhuqn7kZK-kw1wPaYWSkklXd3lCA-y58Jy7p76FEa4VxV2X3F-on_So75PfbZ4cmGg5-pJEAVtgL3A8SttZMnxMyuk8UQTZRHJYXggZDqkPD-FT1E9JNnSQ9Xrevpn8P747ujKAD5zsAzqVXyhq23pJpCR1eKJFvqOLpqkAC4xmztN-z5R05Qe-v0KU7DcE0Ha9dlt2n)

_But we have to keep up our fight until Election Day in 2024, and that_ ’ _s going to take serious resources and dedication from our grassroots team._

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=644%2E135344%2EC4kxoh)

Hi there -- it’s Congressman Jamie Raskin, the Representative for Maryland’s 8th Congressional District.
**Yesterday, I was in Ann Arbor to announce my endorsement of my friend and colleague Elissa Slotkin to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate.**
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230824-1-NOR-30&t=2&akid=644%2E135344%2EC4kxoh) **[Donate to Elissa >>](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230824-1-NOR-30&t=3&akid=644%2E135344%2EC4kxoh)**
I could run through all the bills Elissa and I have worked on together and issues we’ve stood shoulder to shoulder to fight for -- on choice, on voting rights, on infrastructure, on gun violence and more. But today, I just want to tell you the things that come to mind to me when I think about her.
Elissa’s office is right across the hall from mine, so the first first people I see every day when I go to work are Michiganders lined up outside of her office._And the last people I see when I leave work everyday are Michiganders congregating outside of her office._
That’s because she’s meeting with her constituents straight through the day — veterans, students, farmers, labor representatives, small business people. And sometimes when they’re done meeting with her, they stop by my office to say hi. And they always tell me how much they love their Congresswoman.
She’s just about the most accessible politician you can find, and I know she will continue to be accessible to the people across Michigan.
**Something else about Elissa: She’s tough. She’s someone you want on your side in a battle.** She’s always fighting for the right things. She’s the type of tough and compassionate leader we need in the U.S. Senate, but she’s going to need our help to get there.
**[I told Elissa I would help her raise $10,000 to help her build the strong grassroots foundation she’ll need to win. Will you join me in supporting her by chipping in a few dollars to her campaign now?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230824-1-NOR-30&t=4&akid=644%2E135344%2EC4kxoh)**

The only answer is to **SHUT THEM DOWN** , and I am the only presidential candidate who has the plan on how to actually do it.
* We have got to change the conversation. Stop talking about Biden & start talking about what we actually stand for as Republicans. Spouting off poll-tested platitudes about Biden makes us sound like partisan hacks. And that's exactly why it's going to take an outsider from a new generation to get the job done.
* I don't want a national divorce, and other candidates are pushing us toward the brink of that division. I'm running to lead us to a national revival. If we can revive that, then nobody in the world - not a nation, not a corporation, not a virus - will defeat us.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." name: Lesley Lopez
subject: I’m running for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_logo [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_logo]
Hi there, I’m Lesley Lopez, and I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District. Let me explain why I need you with me in this fight.
Maryland’s 6th District has been represented by over forty different men and exactly two women. It’s been 30 years since the last woman was elected to the House from our district. Maryland has not had a woman in federal office since 2017.
I’m running for Congress to change that and more. We need a determined woman who knows how to win fierce battles to fill this open seat and take on the right-wing extremists determined to roll back our progress. A woman with a proven record of delivering results for our reproductive rights, common-sense gun safety to keep our families safe, healthcare access for all our communities, and quality childcare we can actually afford.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_video [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_video]Please, click here to watch my launch video >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=link_cta2]
How do I know I’m tough enough to take on Kevin McCarthy, Mitch McConnell, and the extremist right wing?
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_mom [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_mom]Because I learned how to take on tough challenges from my mom, who raised me as a single parent while on active duty in the US Navy.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_siblings [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_siblings]Later, our small family grew. My stepdad adopted me when I was 14 years old. I gained many new family members along with the last name of Lopez. Growing up in a family with Filipino heritage gave me a more nuanced perspective on race and is just one of the reasons I’m committed to fighting for a more just and equitable society for us all today.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_grandmother [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_grandmother]My grandmother was the most formative figure in my life. She grew up in poverty during the Oklahoma Dust Bowl, and I learned so much through the many nonjudgmental conversations we had during the time I had with her. Sadly, Grandma was taken from us by smoking-related cancer during my senior year of high school.
Even after her death, Grandma continued to inspire me. I got my start in political organizing with a winning campaign to make the amphitheater for graduation smoke-free.
Student loans, financial aid, and a lot of hard work helped me earn my college degree. I worked as a journalist and later as a staffer on the Hill before running for and winning a seat in the Maryland House of Delegates.
In the legislature, I’ve led the fight to protect our reproductive rights, earned bipartisan support banning illegal ghost guns, closed the gap of healthcare workers in rural areas, and lowered childcare costs for Maryland families like mine.
If we work together, I can and will take on a broken Congress to finally pass reasonable gun safety measures on the federal level, address the opioid crisis, and always protect Social Security, Medicare, and our reproductive freedoms.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_grandmother [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_grandmother]I’m Lesley Lopez, and I’m running for Congress. I’ll take on anyone who stands in the way of progress.
But this is an open seat and the district that Kevin McCarthy and Mitch McConnell will work the hardest to flip in Maryland. It’s going to take a tough woman to keep this swing seat blue.
If we work together, I know our campaign’s message will resonate with voters from Garrett County to Gaithersburg. I know we can win this if everyone does their part. Will you follow us on social media to help multiply our digital organizing today?
FACEBOOK » [https://www.facebook.com/LopezforMaryland]
TWITTER » [https://twitter.com/LesleyJLopez]
INSTAGRAM » [https://www.instagram.com/dellesleyjlopez/]
Let’s get going!
Lesley
When she's not busy being a mom to her two toddlers, Lesley Lopez serves the people of Maryland as a Delegate from District 39 in the Maryland General Assembly. Since she was first elected in 2018, Lesley has rapidly become an effective legislator and leader, spearheading efforts to alleviate student debt, improve the delivery and efficiency of health care, and protect the limited financial resources of economically vulnerable Marylanders. Lesley has passed legislation to strengthen gun safety laws and guarantee the rights for all women in the state. She is an adjunct professor at George Washington University and a proud union member of SEIU Local 500. Lesley lives in Germantown, MD, with her husband Richard Kelly, and their two sons, Max and Graham.

[’m Lesley Lopez, and I’m running for Congress. I’ll take on anyone who stands in the way of progress. But this is an open seat and the district that Kevin McCarthy and Mitch McConnell will work the hardest to flip in Maryland. It’s going to take a tough woman to keep this swing seat blue. If we work together, I know our campaign’s message will resonate with voters from Garrett County to Gaithersburg. I know we can win this if everyone does their part. She is an adjunct professor at George Washington University and a proud union member of SEIU Local 500. body:
I need your help to put an end to dangerous Republican anti-voter legislation.
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68578155/423510150/823540626?refcode=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ms=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmUxZTM2ZS04YTQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3ht3rZWPu_rN8LU9Ew0rPqOc61CTigZBg9XRiVqZh5o=&emci=5d191afa-fe41-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=1049176)
Peter, This is a long, but critically important email about voting rights in North Carolina. Please, take a minute to read it. **[Then, I am asking you to take direct action to tell NC Republicans to end their dangerous attacks on voting rights.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68578157/423510152/2049134766?refcode=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ms=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmUxZTM2ZS04YTQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3ht3rZWPu_rN8LU9Ew0rPqOc61CTigZBg9XRiVqZh5o=&emci=5d191afa-fe41-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=1049176)** Right now, legislative Republicans in North Carolina are pushing an all-out assault on the right to vote, using the advice of Trump’s hand-picked election denier, Cleta Mitchell, who was on the call helping him try to overturn the election in Georgia. This attack has nothing to do with election security and everything to do with keeping and gaining power. If you’re a young person, Republicans really don’t want you to vote. If you’re a college student away from home, Republicans really don’t want you to vote. If you’re Black or Brown, Republicans really don’t want you to vote. They’ve done their research and they know when and how you vote, and they know you aren’t as likely to vote for them. They know you can change the outcome of elections. So they’re making it harder for you to vote, hoping you won’t bother. Unfortunately, these schemes aren’t new in North Carolina, and we’ve stopped many of them before. Only this time, Republicans are armed with a one-vote legislative supermajority and a court system stacked with partisan judges who’ve already turned the justice system upside down with two unprecedented election cases decided for Republicans. Now more than ever, we all need to make our voices heard in opposition to attacks on our rights. **[Join me in calling on NC Republicans to end their attacks on the democratic process.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68578159/423510154/2049134766?refcode=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ms=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmUxZTM2ZS04YTQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3ht3rZWPu_rN8LU9Ew0rPqOc61CTigZBg9XRiVqZh5o=&emci=5d191afa-fe41-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=1049176)** Here’s just some of what Republicans want to do in Senate Bills 747 and 749:
* They know that younger and nonwhite voters tend to vote more by absentee ballot or by early voting. So they shortened the time your absentee votes can arrive and still count, and they made it easier to throw them out.
* They know Democrats often win the early vote by large margins, so they want to restrict it. Senate Bill 749 gives legislative Republicans more power to influence how elections are run. So they’ve created a setup that’s a surefire bet to reduce the number of places you can vote early in your county. It could end up being only one voting place — think about how long those lines will be.
* They also want to intimidate you by stacking the polling place with Republican “poll observers” who will be watching you vote and can hear your conversations with election officials. Many of them will be election-denying conspiracy believers trying to disrupt the process and prevent certain people from voting.
* If that’s not enough, they want contested election results to be decided by partisan judges or by the Republican legislators themselves. That’s dangerous.

Today, I’m vetoing Senate Bill 747 and I’ll veto 749 when I get it. **[Click here to tell North Carolina legislators to uphold my vetoes.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68578161/423510156/2049134766?refcode=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ms=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmUxZTM2ZS04YTQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3ht3rZWPu_rN8LU9Ew0rPqOc61CTigZBg9XRiVqZh5o=&emci=5d191afa-fe41-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=1049176)** | [SIGN ON »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68578163/423510158/2049134766?refcode=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ms=ea.b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmUxZTM2ZS04YTQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3ht3rZWPu_rN8LU9Ew0rPqOc61CTigZBg9XRiVqZh5o=&emci=5d191afa-fe41-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=b2e1e36e-8a42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=1049176)

clean_body: I need your help to put an end to dangerous Republican anti-voter legislation. | Peter, This is a long, but critically important email about voting rights in North Carolina. Please, take a minute to read it. Right now, legislative Republicans in North Carolina are pushing an all-out assault on the right to vote, using the advice of Trump’s hand-picked election denier, Cleta Mitchell, who was on the call helping him try to overturn the election in Georgia. This attack has nothing to do with election security and everything to do with keeping and gaining power. If you’re a young person, Republicans really don’t want you to vote. If you’re a college student away from home, Republicans really don’t want you to vote. If you’re Black or Brown, Republicans really don’t want you to vote. They’ve done their research and they know when and how you vote, and they know you aren’t as likely to vote for them. They know you can change the outcome of elections. So they’re making it harder for you to vote, hoping you won’t bother. Unfortunately, these schemes aren’t new in North Carolina, and we’ve stopped many of them before. Only this time, Republicans are armed with a one-vote legislative supermajority and a court system stacked with partisan judges who’ve already turned the justice system upside down with two unprecedented election cases decided for Republicans. Now more than ever, we all need to make our voices heard in opposition to attacks on our rights. Here’s just some of what Republicans want to do in Senate Bills 747 and 749: They know that younger and nonwhite voters tend to vote more by absentee ballot or by early voting. So they shortened the time your absentee votes can arrive and still count, and they made it easier to throw them out. They know Democrats often win the early vote by large margins, so they want to restrict it. Senate Bill 749 gives legislative Republicans more power to influence how elections are run. So they’ve created a setup that’s a surefire bet to reduce the number of places you can vote early in your county. It could end up being only one voting place — think about how long those lines will be. They also want to intimidate you by stacking the polling place with Republican “poll observers” who will be watching you vote and can hear your conversations with election officials. Many of them will be election-denying conspiracy believers trying to disrupt the process and prevent certain people from voting. If that’s not enough, they want contested election results to be decided by partisan judges or by the Republican legislators themselves. That’s dangerous. Today, I’m vetoing Senate Bill 747 and I’ll veto 749 when I get it. | The fight to protect democracy in North Carolina must be won, but we need your help to do it. Friend,
Medicare for All would save taxpayers billions and save countless lives. I'm a family doctor, public health official, medical educator, and social worker.
I'm running for Congress to get it done because of stories like this.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
We need a doctor in the House to lead on this issue.
, I can't do this alone; I need your help getting to DC [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] to be an advocate for change.
if you've saved your payment information with Act Blue Express, your donation will process immediately.

MORE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
,
I've dedicated my life to treating low-income patients. Take it from me: There's no reason parents should receive a medical bill of $700 for a child's 5-minute urgent care visit and X-ray.
A physical exam doesn't have to cost $450, and a pneumonia hospitalization with a price tag of $20,000 is despicable and wrong.
No one should have to crowd-source or go bankrupt because of a medical bill.
Something is deeply wrong with our medical care system when seven healthcare executives have a combined net worth of over $50 billion, but every year, a quarter of a million Americans declare bankruptcy because of medical debt.
The time for complacency is over. It's time to reject the trite excuses and fight for a transformative solutions like Medicare for All and wiping out all medical debt.
Only then can we truly claim to be a nation that values the health and well-being of all its citizens.
If you can contribute, your donation will help us extend our message [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] across the district, state and nation.
Thank you for your consideration.
-Dr. Bob

body:
This month, we are proud to honor Gene Keenon. | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
# Welcome to the August edition of **The Moran Minuteman**.
This monthly newsletter is our way of recognizing extraordinary efforts in Texas Congressional District 1 and providing an inside look into what happens behind the scenes in the life of a Congressman.
---
|
---
| The month of August brought us home to East Texas. August is a month of recess from Congress, but that doesn't mean we don't work. Our team took the opportunity to travel across the district to meet with constituents, businesses, and local elected officials to gain insights into how we can serve you in Washington, D.C.

It's hard to believe, but we are already gearing up for another election season, with the Republican Primary scheduled for Tuesday, March 5. Earlier this month, I spent three days on the road traveling to nine communities across the First District of Texas to announce that I am asking voters to hire me for two more years as your Congressman. We had a great time talking with voters from Center to Texarkana and everywhere in between. If you weren't able to make it to one of the events, I hope I'll see you on the road sometime soon!
---
|
---
|
---
---
| [View More Photos](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=71c1766054&e=bbce4dd6ad "View More Photos")
---
|
---
|
## Congratulations to our August Minuteman -
When I think of East Texans, I think of the [Minutemen of the Revolutionary War](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=5523b9123e&e=bbce4dd6ad). Loyal to country and community, dependable, selfless, and ready at a moment’s notice, the Minutemen were American heroes who helped turn the tide of the Revolutionary War. **Today’s East Texans reflect those traits.** You are patriotic, dependable, and deeply committed to making our communities better.

Each month, I will recognize an East Texan who has gone above and beyond in serving our region - someone who epitomizes the identity of a Minuteman. In addition to recognition in the monthly newsletter, we will send the person a Moran Minuteman t-shirt.

This month’s Minuteman, Gene Keenon, is known across East Texas as a dedicated volunteer and community leader. Over the past 30 years, Gene has served over 30 different communities in some capacity. His countless hours of volunteering for multiple different Chambers of Commerce, Economic Development Corporations, Rotary Clubs, and Beautification Committees have improved the lives of neighbors and the overall environment of East Texas.
---
|
---
| When he nominated Gene for the August Minuteman, Gene’s friend and co-worker Bill Firestone said, “It is an honor to work with Gene and get to see firsthand his dedication and passion around serving our East Texas communities. Gene has a servant heart that radiates pride for all things East Texas. One would be hard-pressed to find a more dedicated, active, and involved leader than Gene.”

Thank you, Gene, for your dedication to East Texas. It is an honor to recognize you as the August 2023 Minuteman.

Do you know an East Texan who would be a great next recipient? Please submit their name **[here](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=b064a1c7c8&e=bbce4dd6ad).**

Our Moran Minuteman team will also be out and about serving at community events and in disaster relief efforts. Look for us, and we’ll toss you a t-shirt!
---
| [Nominate a Minuteman!](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=343022d2be&e=bbce4dd6ad "Nominate a Minuteman!")
---
|
---
|
## Delivering on Promises

When I ran for Congress, I promised to be active in East Texas and present in our communities. Check out this radio segment where I was able to share about some of what we've learned on our travels during the August recess.
---
| [ ](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=eaa45751c2&e=bbce4dd6ad)
---
| As we begin the campaign for two more years in Congress, I pledge to continue seeking your input and taking it to Washington, D.C., where I will work to get government out of the way so our families, businesses, and communities can continue to thrive.
---
| Sincerely,
---
|
---
| Nathaniel Moran Congressman, First District of Texas

Our team took the opportunity to travel across the district to meet with constituents, businesses, and local elected officials to gain insights into how we can serve you in Washington, D.C. It's hard to believe, but we are already gearing up for another election season, with the Republican Primary scheduled for Tuesday, March 5. Earlier this month, I spent three days on the road traveling to nine communities across the First District of Texas to announce that I am asking voters to hire me for two more years as your Congressman. We had a great time talking with voters from Center to Texarkana and everywhere in between. If you weren't able to make it to one of the events, I hope I'll see you on the road sometime soon! | | | "View More Photos" | | Congratulations to our August Minuteman - When I think of East Texans, I think of the . Loyal to country and community, dependable, selfless, and ready at a moment’s notice, the Minutemen were American heroes who helped turn the tide of the Revolutionary War. Today’s East Texans reflect those traits. You are patriotic, dependable, and deeply committed to making our communities better. Each month, I will recognize an East Texan who has gone above and beyond in serving our region - someone who epitomizes the identity of a Minuteman. In addition to recognition in the monthly newsletter, we will send the person a Moran Minuteman t-shirt. This month’s Minuteman, Gene Keenon, is known across East Texas as a dedicated volunteer and community leader. Over the past 30 years, Gene has served over 30 different communities in some capacity. His countless hours of volunteering for multiple different Chambers of Commerce, Economic Development Corporations, Rotary Clubs, and Beautification Committees have improved the lives of neighbors and the overall environment of East Texas. | | When he nominated Gene for the August Minuteman, Gene’s friend and co-worker Bill Firestone said, “It is an honor to work with Gene and get to see firsthand his dedication and passion around serving our East Texas communities. Gene has a servant heart that radiates pride for all things East Texas. One would be hard-pressed to find a more dedicated, active, and involved leader than Gene.” Thank you, Gene, for your dedication to East Texas. It is an honor to recognize you as the August 2023 Minuteman. Do you know an East Texan who would be a great next recipient? Please submit their name . Our Moran Minuteman team will also be out and about serving at community events and in disaster relief efforts. Look for us, and we’ll toss you a t-shirt! | "Nominate a Minuteman!" | | Delivering on Promises When I ran for Congress, I promised to be active in East Texas and present in our communities. Check out this radio segment where I was able to share about some of what we've learned on our travels during the August recess. | | As we begin the campaign for two more years in Congress, I pledge to continue seeking your input and taking it to Washington, D.C., where I will work to get government out of the way so our families, businesses, and communities can continue to thrive. | Sincerely, | | Nathaniel Moran Congressman, First District of Texas | | | | | | VALUES | | EFFORTS | | EXPERIENCE | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright ©2023 Nathaniel Moran for Congress, All rights reserved. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Do you ever look at the current political environment and feel hopeless? For those of us who live in California, it's an easy trap to fall into, but despair is not the right response.

For this week's Hold The Line podcast, I'm joined by Congressman Doug LaMalfa, who has represented California's 1st Congressional District for a decade. Doug is a Believer, and not afraid to Hold the Line, despite living in and representing one of the most left-leaning states in the country.

Doug explains why it is critical for all people, especially for Christians, to be involved in politics and not to flee states like California for greener pastures. It's a timely message that I hope encourages and inspires you to persevere, no matter where God has placed you!

subject: The America I see
body:
If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...

| |
---
| | |
---
| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=76b615b6555347468545d203be59b017&_e=Vqlh7eG8hhmg24bwKuQbI_fWefOeq2QBXoA2gUxkqEtrNiqAw0stM_kBiB92tFsIl0YgkYFyfSyRfcn_3DCRnrT-pXL7vk1XnkBpb2wPue1W0G2RjgCjBvin0xBUziKxweTE59vj6QDqbEZfirrBxMSDgMrXU7iAsP-cqlKnVg9srKO-nIMu-zMBPF1Ri0OeEqk9YqckbuAz-Q21mB_XhFv5r27kHde2vrXsYCz9baVhs3-glBCRaVm2EJtWAHdATEgBsl9XHBQopAH8gc1zDM36ELYkhia-7xuWwyRZQXhcuAH7lVT_nZ1tYKvKVKJCeFn1dr1xJPqpz4wuNoT8iOaxBBgtc-lK_D28jU-A3fIiM0KeDUWLnrlAfADRwRKn "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=76b615b6555347468545d203be59b017&_e=Vqlh7eG8hhmg24bwKuQbI_fWefOeq2QBXoA2gUxkqEtrNiqAw0stM_kBiB92tFsIl0YgkYFyfSyRfcn_3DCRnrT-pXL7vk1XnkBpb2wPue1W0G2RjgCjBvin0xBUziKxweTE59vj6QDqbEZfirrBxMSDgMrXU7iAsP-cqlKnVg9srKO-nIMu-zMBPF1Ri0OeEqk9YqckbuAz-Q21mB_XhFv5r27kHde2vrXsYCz9baUV2dsxRkoAMkeg2UjS7HjbndazhqiKM0V9hu9EQouGzpqsURp3GAk6yofSToeLFdugs09C9C5t6si2O88j4jkcdv3siPaMai1l7mVBbZKfD2SRxm8WiPZfIPiTuznCeNB85cEw7kW1OKaByqr29SoH "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today. ")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=76b615b6555347468545d203be59b017&_e=Vqlh7eG8hhmg24bwKuQbI_fWefOeq2QBXoA2gUxkqEtrNiqAw0stM_kBiB92tFsIl0YgkYFyfSyRfcn_3DCRnrT-pXL7vk1XnkBpb2wPue1W0G2RjgCjBvin0xBUziKxweTE59vj6QDqbEZfirrBxMSDgMrXU7iAsP-cqlKnVg9srKO-nIMu-zMBPF1Ri0OeEqk9YqckbuAz-Q21mB_XhFv5r27kHde2vrXsYCz9baWsXxcHbeQL3Tfa2_XzoRr_knFdQrL4TIxXPs7awY7dciVHIlzYQgp9CBp1r2-djL2s_UBxaa2eREM62RR6bTMY1sftOgxX4E4CtgwqjGwOo63PBBjkFt4b1KxnPnO_Ej0nHG4Xt094qSaU5ND1-9Ve "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

body:
America was founded on these truths that we find sacred and undeniable. Without these truths, our standing as a nation would mean nothing.

|
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhfcumfeoo3h1qpm2a559bau9g7c0hrql8446ho0_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjg6aob2cjh2bs)
Fellow American,

**TRUTH.** There's only one. Not yours, not mine. Just pure TRUTH. In today's bureaucratic political climate where spin is all the Administrative state knows how to do, we stand by cold-hard facts. I'm not afraid to say them:

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** CHIP IN IF YOU BELIEVE IN THE TRUTH **](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8ko40s649j1edp1ig3qjo97lqflpbfk7093lab8_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjg6aob2cjh2bs)
---

America was founded on these truths that we find sacred and undeniable. **Without these truths, our standing as a nation would mean nothing.**

If you agree with these 10 TRUTHS, _**[I need you on my team.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zsns97pm66iadj1j0ve3dj86d84gmrdneugeca18_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjg6aob2cjh2bs)**_

This is about more than a campaign. It is a movement to revive this great nation. **[Will you join me today by chipping in $1 or more?](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z90uecppdt5j7525uc18jk3kohmif8t0ca087n68_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjg6aob2cjh2bs)**

Thanks,

Vivek Ramaswamy

[** STAND WITH THE TRUTH **](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zsmbr05mtovscbuvm6aqmik841mt669k8savjk08_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjg6aob2cjh2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**Both elections were decided by less than 1% — that’s about 20,000 votes.**
Last year’s Senate race in Wisconsin was also decided by a razor-thin margin. Republicans won by 1% after spending a record $77 million to defend GOP Sen. Ron Johnson.
