body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68583681/423529735/-4707655?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTBjYzE4Yy05NDQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h7_mhYzsHWGRkYIUmrvoFSH0OevMyNbdz6_fgzWqfDw=&emci=d347be0a-e03d-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=9e0cc18c-9442-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=19954364) Hey team, I know it can be difficult to keep track of what in the world is happening in Washington sometimes, so I wanted to give you three quick updates on what I’ve been doing recently to serve Colorado’s 7th District. These are the kinds of issues that affect the lives of regular families all across our community — but you’ll rarely hear about them on cable news. 1) Just a few days ago, I introduced the _CONNECT Act of 2023_ , a bipartisan bill that would improve and strengthen the Department of Agriculture’s ReConnect Loan and Grant Program – making it easier for smaller providers to apply for funding and shorten required permitting deadlines. **That description might sound very technical, but the fact is, this bill would be a game changer for rural Colorado, and we need to get it passed.** The internet isn’t a luxury anymore, and the longer these communities go without proper access to it, the more our country’s digital divide will grow. We need to ensure rural mountain communities have consistent access to the vital utilities they need. 2) Last month, I introduced legislation to improve access to mental health care services for America’s farmers and ranchers. Farmers and ranchers are the backbone of many communities in Colorado, but some aren’t getting the support they need – especially in rural areas where care can be hard to find. **Mental health care is health care, and I’m committed to ensuring every Coloradan has access to it, whether they’re children in school, workers ensuring we have food to eat, or seniors trying to enjoy a dignified retirement.** 3) Finally, I was so excited to help announce a**new $20 million grant to replace and improve a major road interchange in Lakewood.** As more people discover that CO-07 is a beautiful place to live, we’ll need strong infrastructure that improves traffic flow and makes it easy for all commuters to get around town. I’m serious about infrastructure, and I’m proud to help bring newer, safer roads and interchanges to our district. Trust me, I know it can be virtually impossible to know what’s going on in Congress. If you got all your news from Twitter or cable news, you’d think it’s nonstop partisan warfare. And while I will always defend against attacks on our fundamental values, I’m also determined to make real progress for our communities wherever I can. And I’m so glad I’m able to share my work directly with supporters like you. I’ll always work day and night for hard-working Coloradans, and I’m proud to help deliver results in every way I can. – Brittany | | [DONATE → ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68583682/423529736/219886618?refcode=email_082423_congress-update&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTBjYzE4Yy05NDQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h7_mhYzsHWGRkYIUmrvoFSH0OevMyNbdz6_fgzWqfDw=)

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. I

Biden, restoring sanity to our nation, fighting for American
freedom, defending parental and family rights, rebuilding our
economy, ending the invasion at our border, and saving this
country from the disastrous policies of our current failing
leaders.

I
stood on that stage last night to be your voice and your fighter,
and I hope I made you proud. I will never back down from standing
up for what YOU need.

I
participated in the first Republican primary debate last night to
make sure that you know that when elected I will be the kind of
leader who will reverse this nation's decline and achieve our
Great American Comeback. If you're with me in the fight that I
laid out at the debate, I'm asking for your support to help me
fight back.

<<

to my campaign here >>

Now
that this first debate is over, it will take ALL OF US to hold
the line. I need your support, Friend, and I am counting on you.
NOW is the time America needs us to step up and change course.

Step up. Save America with me.

⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️

Rush in $25

Rush in $50

Rush in $75

Rush in $100

I
can't do this alone. That debate was a huge opportunity for our
team and we can NOT let it go to waste. By coming together, we
are ditching the Republican culture of losing and the first
debate was only the beginning.

In
Freedom,

Ron
DeSantis

Meet Ron DeSantis

A native Floridian with
blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a
nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin
High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he
was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated
with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission
in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service,
Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah,
Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military
decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service
and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron
also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child
predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a
platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits
and a balanced budget amendment.

In
Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the
weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to
hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in
manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a
veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our
country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans
and expand support for mental health.

In
2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As
governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for
the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when
the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media
united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis
stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding
principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to
transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival.
Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative
priorities:

Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine
mandates,

Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border
crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against
illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured
professors accountable,

Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital
currency,

Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

Protecting the unborn,

Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a
constitutional carry state,

Expanding education freedom,

Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and
entities,

Lowering prescription drug costs,

Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

Creating a universal school choice program,

Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme
Court,

...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout
his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of
nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the
largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than
1.5 million votes.

But
history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the
majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional
wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently
as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30
points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red,
including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties
overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor
DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics,
and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with
battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing
down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his
inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense
suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of
sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even
for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we
choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than
cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe
place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership,
Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education
opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden
Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that
seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to
the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered
the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's
history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:

Record tax relief

ESG prohibitions

Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering
transparency

Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

Improvements to our state's infrastructure

Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death
penalty for child rapists

The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border
crisis

Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward
school unions

Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No
leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor
DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country,
leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron
is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television
anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters,
Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

| Peter, While Bill is out on the trail, working to bring common sense back to New Jersey and beyond, we'll be rebroadcasting a favorite episode of the Common Ground Podcast at 4:30PM ET today.
**Today's topic revolves around fighting for families and small businesses.** There is no better way to serve the needs of the people than by focusing on families and small businesses, the backbone of our communities. New Jersey politics has to be local, with leaders who understand the challenges facing our communities and have the experience and determination to address them.
---
| | [CLICK HERE TO ACCESS THE COMMON GROUND STREAM NOW (LIVE AT 4:30PM EDT)](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/b271b04ed457eeb88ef151ebcdc328e7/eJyNj0ELgkAQhf_LnCVZtQJvIiKieYg6h-lQS-u6rKNk4n9vrfBU0HXme9_jjUAoC0lJBT7c6eE4LligseSKo6SwkVSUr6-z9pjLLBBc3mLddAr88Wt4AeYzc7cbC2hQaJDDPgjTJI9PWZKnhlSFNh3_eRjzFk-0C5IMpumnGGtOUW_cLfikO5wXVdysoqMWhr8Sqda37bKp60ZeTImsVqXozrbgPRpBoRTK6rM-xeGtmZ4ZHmLc)

| Today's stream features two guests who spend a lot of time advocating for New Jersey's citizens: Jennifer Love and Rosemary Becchi. Cranford mother Jennifer Love has been advocating for the passage of "Emma's Law," a bill that requires additional safety features on school buses for special needs children, since 2018. The bill is named after Love's non-verbal daughter, who had a traumatizing experience when the school bus she was on was lost and out of touch for five hours.
Rosemary Becchi is a business policy expert, a tax specialist, and attorney who doubles as a political advocate. As a result of seeing the harm inflicted on families and businesses from high taxes and uncontrolled government spending, Rosemary started Jersey First, a non-profit organization with the mission to educate and advocate for policy solutions to lower taxes, reduce government spending and help put New Jersey’s economy back on track.
**In the end, it all comes down to putting the needs of the people first. That means listening to our communities, understanding their unique challenges, and working together to find solutions.** It means building a brighter future for our families and small businesses, and ensuring that New Jersey remains a great place to live, work, and raise a family. Make sure you [**join us now (the encore stream will start at 4:30PM EST),**](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/af6df0100100d2df9077353f47f57418/eJyNj0ELgkAQhf_LnCVZNYK9iUiI5iHqHLYOtaTrso6Sif-9taIuBV1nvvc93giEqlCUlMDhSjfP88EBg0JqiYqiRlEhHl9vGTCfOVBJdVmbptPAx6_hNzCfmb8KHKBBo0V22zBKk3x9yJI8taQujO34z8PYxxNvwiSDafopxlpS3Ft3C5xMh_OiUtpVtDeV5c9EuuWuK5q6btTJlqhyIaru6FayRysotEZVvtanODw10x0XiGLa) Common Sense Action Team
---
|
---
| The Gloucester County GOP has just announced that Riley Gaines will be the keynote speaker at the 6th Annual Chairwoman’s Reception! This special event will be happening on Tuesday, September 19th at 6PM at Adelphia Restaurant in Deptford, New Jersey. [Learn more and save your spot here.](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/2eb918c7c9706d2e7d9c6c401e30bbd8/eJyNkUtvwjAQhP-LD5wIiR3nQaSoQgihCMqhas-RsRdwwY86TluK-O81UHFqpZ5Wmv08o1mfkAfNtG8EqtCn_yIkRUPkgEsrQfup0Z7x65ZkFKd4iA5S7-fO9BZVp18f34GLjNOCDJE_WgjI89NkumhW83bZrBaBtMyFjP_5YEzvPrPHSbNE5_OfxqCkn70H7w5V3vVwaSRkaOVf3CHwO-9tV8VxB7x3MGIahPEjblS85fo1cC2hcU43WZmTIirzMY5owsqoFFhEa0KAlZiWgvKH3qu2M73jUN9cBhdFhbRe1W-u5UbAVeJMWSa3uiYJSfmOSfdhFNNdCAPrpdEDqTcBv9673cOx5jnOBGRjkiebLA2zIGvBClysx0nJ0iz0ZNaCFj-ftIDjre35G5RymZw=) Riley Gaines is a former University of Kentucky swimmer who stepped into the spotlight last year when she first spoke out against men competing in women’s sports. Gaines became a 12-time NCAA All-American swimmer and a five-time SEC champion. But last year, the integrity of her sport — and female sports as a whole — was called into question when University of Pennsylvania swimmer Lia Thomas, who had competed on the school’s men’s team his freshman, sophomore and junior years, began shattering records in the women’s category.
Riley can recall wondering why no one was standing up for her or for any women in the room when a man was awarded the 2022 NCAA Women's Swimming Championships. This moment became her call to action: she felt compelled to defend and protect America’s daughters against the woke left and their gender-denying ideology. Riley has actively pursued her mission by speaking at events and making media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s sports and uphold vital truths. I spoke to Riley in our Common Ground podcast. Listen to her story HERE. Everything that Riley Gaines stands for is common sense. Click here to learn more about the 6th Annual Chairwoman's Reception that Riley will be headlining as the keynote speaker. Let's come together on September 19th to make a statement, to inspire change, and to take the reins of America's future. We look forward to standing with you. Until next time, Bill & The Common Sense Action Team

name: Robert Garcia
subject: Hurricane Hilary
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Robert Garcia for Congress
body:
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68587326/423543255/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmFkN2ExOS05YjQyLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a8j36PkLu3zIGpdNNRdGw1MWBJn5VCBZcGr-1HJTsNM=)
Friends —
This past week, California experienced a surge of climate disasters — some of the toughest in its history.
Tropical storm Hilary landed in Southern California on Monday — the first tropical storm to hit California in 84 years. Trees toppled, roads and bridges flooded, power lines were downed, and many homes and residences were damaged. But that's not where the natural disasters end. Simultaneously, Los Angeles experienced an earthquake and wildfires.
This week has made it more apparent than ever that the consequences of climate change are here to stay.
Hilary damaged Southern California in ways no one had expected — it’s estimated that an entire year’s worth of rain fell on California in one day.
That’s not normal.

In this episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Darrell Hartman, author of the recently released book "[Battle of Ink and Ice: A Sensational Story of News Barons, North Pole Explorers, and the Making of Modern Media](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LQKzRB8tMXYg4X9sGe6N-8V_QKOFl8J3mtwghn9kglZLzJsPgLKfOTiGa7aLmOIwLeCHCpH_tW4XNQ4KpZwKzBb39bWEv-x0gTQpH77NtG1L8sLGBia1BV3-YiyvzMuYvFTQpedYCWHWbVqNpftdnA==&c=WjQcPw3Y_bVgdMjC2GWydqeB5ID5tJUspu75olVBH8-RRUaCsMUZGw==&ch=4hFa6LlYdeKSOUUM9X6I8JeLmfGEa9ewWIBFHkFFZqpOJ2VCXkKRQA==)." The book is a gripping tale of a competition to discover the North Pole and pitted The New York Times and New York Herald against each other. By raising issues of populism, class structure, the power of celebrity status, and a powerful media with vested interests, the book overflows with contemporary relevance. In addition to talking about the book, Darrell also discusses his path from Maine to Yale and to the world of travel writing.
Tune in to the conversation via the links below!

subject: This is the most personal email you’ll read today
body:
I never thought that my own government would spy on me.

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhd3plm923svl513eo1s9f5ktsereg31r654ok20_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjg69p71cth2bs)

Hello Friend,

I never thought that my own government would spy on me.

I have always loved my country.

That's why I've dedicated my life to being a public defender, a federal prosecutor, and a legal liaison to the United States Armed Forces. I believe in the foundational values of America - life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.

So when Devin Nunes asked me to help with the Russiagate investigation, I told him whatever we discovered about President Trump, _good or bad_ , it had to be published.

When I started my investigation, I hadn't even met President Trump. **But this investigation changed my life forever ...**

_Trump did NOT collude with Russia_.

**My investigation discovered the FBI 's unlawful investigation. And what I found makes me believe that they did it _intentionall_ y to get rid of President Trump.**

It's why I refer to the Russia Gate FBI cabal as government gangsters. They are crooks who abuse their power to extort our elected officials. Their deep connections with the media enable a manufacturing machine of fake news.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Whether it was tackling out-of-control spending, securing our border, taking on China and Russia, standing up for our girls, or laying out my plan to make America strong and proud, I made sure to have an honest discussion with the American people. We need a new generation of leadership in the White House, and I am ready to get to work. We have a country to save, but I need your help to make that happen. "Can I count on your support so we can reach every American with my message, win the White House, and SAVE our future?" | | | Friend, in the greatest nation in history, 78% of our country is worried their kids won't be better off. That is NOT okay. My parents came here more than 50 years ago to an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to see America again. When we focus on faith, family, and the fact that America is the best country in the world, that's when our best days are ahead of us. "I’m putting in the work. Will you join me in the fight for our country’s future? " "If you agree with my vision for our country’s future – an America that is STRONG and PROUD, NOT WEAK and WOKE – please rush in a donation today." We've got a country to save, and with you on my side, that's exactly what we're going to do. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. | | Friend, In President Biden’s latest show of bumbling buffoonery, a visit to Hawaii went off the rails more than once. He was already met with[ chants of protest](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d7ac4608b8344369b73b70d1c2aff7a0&_e=irqaalgwkHmiSV3lxfSBW7IaSFQXr93-46RNyMaH2Ou_XtPC9vNmXLtl3nwP8m_IbW6YlL622kqqcbubz26ZEW5xuGzkemj806X4lpfyH5YLDJZ9lIHFInUDNaCDpWHvLLF4nNZFup7bKrPMc_Y44ShIC84F0wTifizU0QZ7TrTP3PCzlqZElDPEU8aHfWtMzuWrcChiPQvz_tOq7fR3pm792ue3-Vikuq7HtYbO_tjBNTF3KoX47p5zyRp3eFaKIjyd71q7G7OnRJbv9F-bhpVraXX2lBB2G45VX2wt3qM%3D) and signs that read, “No Comment,” after repeatedly failing to address the tragedy last week. The devastating fires in Maui have been declared the deadliest in the U.S. in more than a century. The fire killed roughly 110 people, but more than 1,000 are still [unaccounted for](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d7ac4608b8344369b73b70d1c2aff7a0&_e=irqaalgwkHmiSV3lxfSBW9geu7t9yg5ufkThlIgw4WExGO53Gbw0_Bw89BUHuWq8ZPB8xjO9rWlZWa0IxdpnIDDvR4xqC4w3o16nZ7bVwHLvlR4R4ZllksXwA4Kn_Rg5CASwVmv0BtAIUbcEmYqc0HUsChF6AqzZVl-A8aK9UBLIuraG9OXgdjGPc9yqq4Snd9-I6xBRSLFVwwtWBZii7T13FqsWclFn0lbtDB3ijp6QYFEM9tQikKEo0v6C8WSx5RtXE30T3UShucY7VEM-e5SQnFWrXFZqoitxls1YTyE%3D). We’re in the middle of an unfathomable disaster, and once again, the elephant in the room is our president’s lack of sharpness. He stood before victims and their families, rambling on and on, [unable to pronounce](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d7ac4608b8344369b73b70d1c2aff7a0&_e=irqaalgwkHmiSV3lxfSBW39a_Ifvh0epIa1rhCk0b5H4g2vGI-BeBj_8EPQo-6E-5EXitEGG5p-aR6f87kyxrZBZZdxmCrtXeyzyXazZ8oB-tN_xsQHwC9FkzYUYTZBXlzw41KtAbtVAxlV3iG6vdGgOmnhJ4oOCpZJF0BJu3vrnxDYZBs8Cq7qwnG-4PT389tDOHauRS8jAe25tS_ayNn0TvRklyk8DaCQcKkeEkxSHxLt8AKwZFK5ClM3bngc-MrGz_-lUM7L1xE2fkGoisZiQ4mRWeztikqZKehbfo4Y%3D) the names of Maui officials. But that’s not the worst part. Biden recounted a story about a small kitchen fire in his home 15 years ago. He bellyached about almost losing his [’67 Corvette](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d7ac4608b8344369b73b70d1c2aff7a0&_e=irqaalgwkHmiSV3lxfSBW10lCXnSo3sqyQN8hGLHc-HcUsOgNPLYshzo8ak8Q-z0vx05U7rrkKaiM4TgPHZTKx1530lzhAtC0HwDaWBQt8EQrZSTrgSLqF_e3749Q17smdtncAIAzHPH7uzGzKlg8fePPA1GSbQCjXXQXEtKjzsK2v2EcsMSChLxQiQgvJTEfHkV8ti3jp-DJIREfkgGebf8REwQwVJIxMIzuVM9-yeUxpjbbiYfl2NLEt3cfTnKO30fhrg6WXDCuJlo5-lCysEEpysxtq9gaRoLOaXru8tn3wLPp---gowXnhCxEJSxEdB82PUZIwqdRAjmd_5q1g%3D%3D). Can someone teach this man how to read the room? Friend, just like Tim and Team Burchett, we’re sure you’re embarrassed by President Biden’s response to this disaster. Hi Friend,

**My name is Vivek Ramaswamy, and I am running for President of the United States. **

Our country is facing an identity crisis. When you ask people, “what does it mean to be an American?” you get a blank stare.

Meanwhile, Democrats are seeking to **DIVIDE** us and make us forget about all the reasons that we are **PROUD** to be Americans.

The Radical Left is**_OBSESSED_** with wokeness and gender ideology. They want to divide you based on race, gender, and political views.

**[That’s not okay. I’m running for President to stop the Left’s WOKE agenda.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._cvgrxK_hyxYDlr-40g "That’s not okay. I’m running for President to stop the Left’s WOKE agenda. ")**

We need to revive the ideals that set this nation into motion over 250 years ago. Our country was founded on excellence, merit, free speech, Democratic self-governance over aristocracy. A nation of laws.

The same values that provide hope to the free world.

I am running for President with a vision to rediscover our national identity. E Pluribus Unum: When we stand as one, _**NOTHING**_ can stop us. That includes having a strong House Majority to support the next President.

No amount of pandering, avoiding the question, cross-talk, or meaningless platitudes can hide the truth: Every one of the Republican candidates for president would work to restrict abortion in America. Whether they said it onstage or not, we know these candidates would work in lockstep with a Republican Congress to pass federal abortion bans. We also know, because we've seen it happen, that this Party is very willing to subvert democracy and remake our judicial branch into a conservative hellscape. That's where we come in. Holding the Senate, flipping the House, and reelecting Joe Biden and Kamala Harris next year are crucial in order to stop Republicans' attacks on abortion in their tracks. We can do all of that by electing Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot. If you can, please donate to EMILYs List to help BEAT Republicans and ELECT pro-choice leaders everywhere: Together, we can make sure none of what we saw on stage last night ends up in the halls of power. GOP Debate Key Take Away: Chris Christie: Direct, Honest, Can Beat Joe Biden | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/1800edd1f111/what-they-are-saying-about-chris-christie-13560036?e=d0a9afa930)

**GOP Debate Key Takeaway: Chris Christie: Direct, Honest, Can Beat Joe Biden

** Last night on the debate stage Governor Chris Christie made his case to Republican Party primary voters by answering the questions directly and telling the truth.
He focused on the issues and was the only candidate to make the compelling argument that in order to defeat Joe Biden in November 2024, we must move on from Donald Trump.

“He displayed the traits and qualities that made him successful in New Jersey during his early years in office. He gave articulate, intelligent responses but was fearless and aggressive in a non-offensive or pompous manner.”
“Quite frankly, Christie looked like a conservative Republican who could defeat Joe Biden and take on the toxic left-wing politicians in the Democratic Party.”-Christopher Tremoglie, 8/24/23
One thing was made clear in the first GOP debate: no candidate bested Chris Christie in both form & substance. Judge for yourself with these debate moments:
**Zinger Of The Night: “Sounds Like ChatGPT, Amateur Like Obama”**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=2663aa4226&e=d0a9afa930)
[James Hohmann, The Washington Post](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=8e87c78fd9&e=d0a9afa930): “...Chris Christie scored a Marco Roboto style hit when he turned that Obama line back on him like jujitsu.”
**Chris Christie: Stand For The Constitution**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=ae85ee4c9d&e=d0a9afa930)
[The Wall Street Journal Editorial Board](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=7b0bee49dd&e=d0a9afa930): “Even if GOP voters think, rightly, that Democrats are using prosecution as a political weapon, tens of millions also know in their hearts that Mr. Christie is right.”
**Best Answer To The Dumbest Question**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=30c0199282&e=d0a9afa930)
[Clay Travis](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=5fc828e83b&e=d0a9afa930): “That was a phenomenal answer from Chris Christie to the UFO question. I guarantee no one prepped for that. On his feet, fantastic pivot. Probably his best moment of the night.”
**Profile In Courage**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=7edf4584ef&e=d0a9afa930)
[Tim Carney, Washington Examiner](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=00bf69f9c6&e=d0a9afa930): "Whether or not you think the criminal charges are right or wrong, the conduct is beneath the office of the President of the United States.’ Amen, Chris Christie.”
**A Conservative Governor From A Blue State**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=56a71ab1fb&e=d0a9afa930)
[Frank Luntz](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=9ee6f53e1f&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie gave the perfect electability argument in his closing statement. No one else can make that argument. #GOPDebate

body:
Over 200 million people and counting have tuned into Tucker’s interview with Pres. Donald J. Trump – making it the most watched interview of all-time.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/ac47b3ef1a8f/breaking-records-over-200-million-watch-tuckers-interview-of-trump?e=1cb5fdae9e)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Illinois Review eBlast Powered By
https://kasparlaw.co/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
https://www.bestdental.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Breaking Records: Over 200 Million People Tuned into Tucker's Interview with Trump, as Vivek Dominated DeSantis on GOP Primary Debate Stage, and Trump Makes Ratings History (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/breaking-records-over-200-million-people-tuned-into-tuckers-interview-with-trump-as-vivek-dominated-desantis-on-gop-primary-debate-stage-and-trump-makes-ratings-history.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/breaking-records-over-200-million-people-tuned-into-tuckers-interview-with-trump-as-vivek-dominated-desantis-on-gop-primary-debate-stage-and-trump-makes-ratings-history.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene (R, GA-14) is spotted at the GOP Primary Debate in Milwaukee watching the Tucker interview with Trump, which broke ratings history. (Photo credit: Glenn Greenwald/X)

Over 200 million people – and counting – have tuned into Tucker Carlson’s interview with President Donald Trump (https://twitter.com/TuckerCarlson/status/1694513603251241143?s=20&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – making it the most watched interview of all-time – which was released on the social media platform X at the same time as Fox News’ Republican Primary debate, in a deliberate dig at both the Republican National Committee and the one-time popular cable news channel which has purposely distanced itself from the widely popular former president in recent years.
https://twitter.com/TuckerCarlson/status/1694513603251241143?s=20&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
On Sunday, Trump announced that he would not participate in Wednesday’s debate – and there’s no reason to. A recent CBS News Poll (https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-poll-indictments-2023-08-20/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) has Trump leading second place Fl. Gov. Ron DeSantis by 46 points and third place Vivek Ramaswamy by 55 points.
https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-poll-indictments-2023-08-20/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
A recent CBS News Poll shows President Trump with a commanding lead in the Republican presidential primary.

Trump’s interview with Tucker purposely drew tens of millions away from the Fox News debate, but for the small audience tuning in, and those in attendance in Milwaukee – it was clear that Ramaswamy – a young 38-year old with no political experience – was last night’s debate winner.

Not only did he take center stage at the debate, but he also received a majority of the attacks from his fellow candidates – proving that Ramaswamy’s long shot campaign is gaining momentum as the battle for second place heats up.

And after the debate, informal polls showed Ramaswamy as the clear winner.

Over 138,000 people voted in the Drudge Report’s informal poll, and Ramaswamy was ahead of DeSantis by 15 points, 32-18.
An informal Drudge Report poll, with over 180,000 votes, showed Vivek Ramaswamy beating Fl. Gov. Ron DeSantis in Wednesday night’s debate by 15 points.

A political newbie, Ramaswamy is feeling the pressures of the national spotlight, and just recently, he made a political blunder by suggesting that the US cut aid to Israel (https://www.newsmax.com/newsfront/ramaswamy-israel-aid/2023/08/21/id/1131462/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – a strong ally and partner of the US for over 75 years.

During his presidency, President Trump balanced America First policies, while at the same time, supporting key allies like Israel, even financially.

On Monday, IR’s editor-in-chief Mark Vargas went on Newsmax to talk about Ramaswamy’s blunder, even predicting that he expects Ramaswamy will travel overseas soon to show some foreign policy credentials – an area where he is lacking real expertise on the campaign trail.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rI4rtneJsZk&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Editor-in-Chief Mark Vargas Joins Newsmax to Discuss Vivek's Foreign Policy Inexperience on the Campaign Trail.
But the second biggest news of the day, besides the record-breaking interview with Trump, was the arrest of former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani in Georgia earlier in the day.

On Wednesday, Giuliani arrived in Atlanta, Georgia, to turn himself in – marking a sad and dark day in our history – as Democrats – including the Biden Justice Department, continue to weaponize the justice system to target their political enemies – and in this case, for questioning local election results – something the Democrats have done for decades.

But all the mainstream media wanted to focus on was his mode of transportation – and why he arrived on a
private jet (https://www.cnn.com/videos/politics/2023/08/23/rudy-giuliani-plane-arrives-georgia-vpx.cnn?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) despite mounting legal bills.
https://www.cnn.com/videos/politics/2023/08/23/rudy-giuliani-plane-arrives-georgia-vpx.cnn?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
CNN devoted an entire segment on live television to speculate about the private jet that brought Giuliani to his arraignment in Atlanta.
In an interview with Newsmax (https://www.newsmax.com/newsmax-tv/rudy-giuliani-indictment-georgia/2023/08/23/id/1131806/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) on Wednesday, Mayor Giuliani made a powerful point – warning attorneys across the country that he was being prosecuted simply for representing his client:
“They operate like communists...this was a terrible thing. And it’s not because of me....look at all the attorneys that are being prosecuted here. I’m basically being prosecuted for doing what I’ve done...over and over again as part of my profession. And in my case, I believe I was defending and advocating for an innocent man.”
President Trump is expected to be arraigned for a fourth time on Thursday afternoon in Georgia.
https://kasparlaw.co/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=fdb7481104-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_24_04_11&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fdb7481104-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

body:
Not a single GOP presidential candidate on the debate stage put forth a plan to combat gun violence
#

Friends -
Last night, none of the presidential candidates on the Republican Primary Debate stage—or Donald Trump—introduced a plan to combat gun violence.
Let that sink in. Not a single one chose to speak about our nation’s top public health crisis, or to even acknowledge that gun violence _is_ a crisis.
Right now, we live in a country where guns kill more than **115** people each day.
We live in a country where guns are the **_number one**_ killer of our nation’s children.
We live in a country where Democrats, Republicans, and Independent voters alike are strongly in favor of commonsense gun safety legislation. _Fox News_ reported that **87%** of voters want to require criminal background checks on all gun purchases.
And yet, none of the Republican candidates on that stage have the courage to do what’s right and fight our nation’s gun violence epidemic. All because they are too busy cozying up to the gun lobby.
Luckily, we already have a president in office who is fighting to make our communities safer. President Joe Biden has proven we can count on him to stand up to the gun lobby and pass transformative gun safety legislation, like the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act._
**Now it’s up to us to make sure we have four more years of a Biden-Harris administration leading the charge on gun safety.**

| | Did you watch the first Republican presidential debate of the 2024 cycle? If not, we don't blame you — that's not our ideal evening entertainment, either. But here are our key takeaways from the debate stage in Milwaukee:
* **Trump is (still, somehow) dominating the conversation.**
Even when he's not on the debate stage, (hanging out on Twitter with Tucker is similar, right?) Trump is still a driving force for discussion. They all have a similar ideology and many said they would still support him even if he was convicted. When it comes down to it, these folks will never break up with Trump – if they aren't the nominee themselves, they'll do and say _anything_ to make it onto his VP shortlist.

* **Despite national polling showing upwards of 70% of Americans are pro-choice, the GOP will continue its attack on reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy. It's just a matter of how far they feel comfortable going in primary season.**
DeSantis lauded his aggressive restrictions to reproductive freedom, while the only woman on the stage, Nikki Haley, continued her habit of dodging the question. A real girl's girl, she suggested that a nationwide abortion ban wouldn't be able to get the 60 Senate votes needed to pass — but narrower legislation in the states could work. Gee thanks, Nikki.

* **For Trump and his MAGA followers, the 2020 election will forever be "stolen."**
Tucker Carlson played right into one of Trump's longest-lasting and most destructive claims: that he won the 2020 election and that Joe Biden is an illegitimate president. They even played up the idea that the same thing could happen again in 2024. We all know his radical followers are capable of real harm the more he pushes and the more they believe that we are not living in a free democracy.

* **And don't worry — that unprecedented hurricane in Southern California, rampant wildfires across the continent, and jacuzzi temperatures in the Atlantic are no big deal. Climate change is still a hoax.**

It's going to be a _long_ election season. clean_body: Movement Labs’ key takeaways from the GOP presidential debates in Milwaukee. | | | | Did you watch the first Republican presidential debate of the 2024 cycle? If not, we don't blame you — that's not our ideal evening entertainment, either. But here are our key takeaways from the debate stage in Milwaukee: Trump is (still, somehow) dominating the conversation. Even when he's not on the debate stage, (hanging out on Twitter with Tucker is similar, right?) Trump is still a driving force for discussion. They all have a similar ideology and many said they would still support him even if he was convicted. When it comes down to it, these folks will never break up with Trump – if they aren't the nominee themselves, they'll do and say anything to make it onto his VP shortlist. Despite national polling showing upwards of 70% of Americans are pro-choice, the GOP will continue its attack on reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy. It's just a matter of how far they feel comfortable going in primary season. DeSantis lauded his aggressive restrictions to reproductive freedom, while the only woman on the stage, Nikki Haley, continued her habit of dodging the question. A real girl's girl, she suggested that a nationwide abortion ban wouldn't be able to get the 60 Senate votes needed to pass — but narrower legislation in the states could work. Gee thanks, Nikki. For Trump and his MAGA followers, the 2020 election will forever be "stolen." Tucker Carlson played right into one of Trump's longest-lasting and most destructive claims: that he won the 2020 election and that Joe Biden is an illegitimate president. They even played up the idea that the same thing could happen again in 2024. We all know his radical followers are capable of real harm the more he pushes and the more they believe that we are not living in a free democracy. And don't worry — that unprecedented hurricane in Southern California, rampant wildfires across the continent, and jacuzzi temperatures in the Atlantic are no big deal. Climate change is still a hoax. Washington State just made the news. But, not in a good way. Washington just overtook California as the state with the highest gas prices in the country.

There are always a lot of factors that determine gas prices, but our state adds to the cost with our carbon pricing auctions, which are set higher than California’s.

**I want to be clear: I supported this legislation when its stated goal was adding pennies to the price at the pump in return for meaningful climate action** – _but I knew we needed additional legislation to make sure those pennies didn’t turn into the 40 or 50 cent spikes we’re seeing today._

I proposed legislation to solve this exact problem, but it failed to pass in the State Senate.

**We can't sacrifice working families who are struggling to fill up their tanks at the gas station in our efforts to stop climate change – we need to find a balance as we carve the path forward.**

The revenue we’re raising from our carbon pricing auction allows us to invest in green projects around the state like electrifying our ports, improving fish passage, and addressing water supply for the Yakima, Columbia, and Chehalis river basins.

But with housing, groceries, and other consumables dramatically increasing in price over the last couple years, __Washington State families are feeling the squeeze and too many families will have to choose between gas to get to work and other essentials.__ **That’s not right.**

We need to be innovative and take care to avoid putting policies in place that make Washington unaffordable. Our transition to a green economy won’t be strong if we don’t protect working folks in our state.

I’m proud of my work in the State Senate on this issue, but the rise in gas prices is a clear sign that we need to do more.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts on this issue with me,

Mark

|

name: America Fitzpatrick, LCV
subject: URGENT: Tell the Biden Administration NO NEW Offshore Drilling
body:
Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv. ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/L6b_

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director

clean_body: Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA: PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur. Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again. GOAL: 5,000 actions TAKE ACTION ? ? ? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents. This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health. Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces. Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks. But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers. Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters. Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters. Sincerely, Madeleine Foote Deputy Legislative Director League of Conservation Voters ? ? ? ? ? name: Ro Khanna
subject: Every American deserves affordable housing
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

The median rent for a one-bedroom apartment in the US is $1,231 a month. This means that, at $15 an hour, it would take an Amazon warehouse worker 246 hours a month—or 56 hours a week—to afford rent.

Guess how long it would take Jeff Bezos? 1.5 seconds.

[https://act.rokhanna.com/a/privatization-of-housing-petition?contactdata=nGlAuF7SeiDaBjcoakG3P4814AGRRcRZ559aowuc74N7VAcEtaP+yjiBssngaGb8GqIhGSsQhmr1vCm7AIXv5FIaFPtbEIYMSxmVcLiA00o2bWny4PwZQ4f4INtWXuqeDHyhijHNgv0bfCtJ2sxhiw==]

Rent shouldn't cost more than 30% of your salary. Yet this is the reality for 21.6 million American households, according to Harvard’s The State of the Nation’s Housing 2023 study.

Sign the petition: Congress must pass the Stop Wall Street Landlords Act! [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/privatization-of-housing-petition?contactdata=nGlAuF7SeiDaBjcoakG3P4814AGRRcRZ559aowuc74N7VAcEtaP+yjiBssngaGb8GqIhGSsQhmr1vCm7AIXv5FIaFPtbEIYMSxmVcLiA00o2bWny4PwZQ4f4INtWXuqeDHyhijHNgv0bfCtJ2sxhiw==]

We have an affordable housing crisis in America, and corporate greed is making it worse. Wall Street enables private equity firms to snap up single-family residential homes nationwide. This not only allows corporations to charge excessive rents, but it also blocks the road to homeownership, making the American Dream harder than ever to reach, especially for working- and middle-class families.

It’s time for Congress to put an end to Wall Street’s real estate grab by passing my Stop Wall Street Landlords Act. This legislation would ban private equity firms from obtaining loans backed by the Federal Housing Finance Agency and related government entities for the purchase of single-family residential homes, while also cutting off taxpayer funding for existing loans. With these tax savings, the federal government would then establish neighborhood homes tax credits to offset the cost of constructing or rehabilitating owner-occupied homes for state and local governments.

Whether they seek to rent or to own, every American deserves access to affordable housing. Let’s tell Congress to pass the Stop Wall Street Landlords Act and stamp out housing inequality.

Sign if you agree: Passing the Stop Wall Street Landlords Act will end our affordable housing crisis. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/privatization-of-housing-petition?contactdata=nGlAuF7SeiDaBjcoakG3P4814AGRRcRZ559aowuc74N7VAcEtaP+yjiBssngaGb8GqIhGSsQhmr1vCm7AIXv5FIaFPtbEIYMSxmVcLiA00o2bWny4PwZQ4f4INtWXuqeDHyhijHNgv0bfCtJ2sxhiw==]

In solidarity,
Ro

body:

Hi friend,

We can take them on and win, but it’s going to require lots of people stepping up and getting involved.

**So what do you say?**

subject: What a night!

body:

Fellow American,

When I stepped off the stage, I could feel electricity in the air. _This campaign has built tremendous momentum and we aren't letting up for a minute._

For those of you who have been with me since the beginning, you know how big this victory was. We started this campaign back in late February polling at 0.0%. My vision is for an America more unified by our founding ideals than torn apart by our perceived differences.

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT **](http://trk.libertyledger._g)
---

My Republican opponents offered a lot of great points tonight but here's why my campaign is different:
* I'm going to revolutionize the way our government is run. _The people who we elect to run the government are NOT the ones who actually run the government_. It's the managerial class in the Deep State. You cannot reform these agencies. The only answer is to **SHUT THEM DOWN** , and I am the only presidential candidate who has the plan on how to actually do it.
* We have got to change the conversation. Stop talking about Biden & start talking about what we actually stand for as Republicans. Spouting off poll-tested platitudes about Biden makes us sound like partisan hacks. And that's exactly why it's going to take an outsider from a new generation to get the job done.
* I don't want a national divorce, and other candidates are pushing us toward the brink of that division. I'm running to lead us to a national revival. If we can revive that, then nobody in the world – not a nation, not a corporation, not a virus – will defeat us.

**[Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 20 weeks until the first primary election. Chip in $20 today and together, let's make America our first priority.](http://trk.libertyledger.)**

_Fellow American – are you ready for the revolution?_

America First,

[](http://trk.libertyledger.-qa8RzW7lPQ)
Vivek Ramaswamy

[** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT →**](http://trk.libertyledger.)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. body:
Cori Bush introduced groundbreaking bills to end solitary confinement and transform our system of public safety. | |
---
Peter, Around 122,000 people in federal and state prisons and jails are trapped in solitary confinement for 22 hours or more each day. This is torture, and it’s disproportionately inflicted on Black and brown folks, young people, LGBTQ+ people, and other marginalized communities. **Rep. Cori Bush refuses to accept this status quo, so she recently introduced the _End Solitary Confinement Act_** , which would end solitary confinement in federal prison and detention facilities and expand protections for incarcerated people’s right to due process. The bill would also incentivize states and local governments to end solitary confinement in state and local facilities. **Cori has been calling to end the harms of our racist criminal legal system since she was on the streets of the Ferguson Uprising as an activist and a nurse.** During a protest, Cori herself was violently brutalized by police while trying to help a woman with a medical emergency. As the first activist from the movement for Black lives to be elected to Congress, Cori understands how urgently we need change. She engaged with community groups around the country on her just-reintroduced bill, the _People's Response Act_ , which supports cities, states, tribal governments, and community-based organizations in launching and scaling public health alternatives to policing. body:

---
[](https://frontlinepolicy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=76b6d09b543e994ba84fb0b89&id=00083acaf5&e=aa3cd9f471)
Do you ever get frustrated watching the news?
We are a nation in crisis. An intense partisan divide rages, a general lack of civility has left many feeling isolated or seeking to cloister among those who see things the same way they do, and there is a fundamental disagreement over what is true, right, and good.
At Frontline, we know that, together, we can make a difference – we can see our nation turn around and we can see our state lead the way.
By standing on timeless biblical principles, we can build a better future for the next generation where all life is cherished, opportunity abounds, freedom is protected, faith is honored, and the family is restored.
_**With your help, we can end the frustration, win others to our cause, change the direction of our culture, and improve the lives of our fellow citizens.**_
Our organizations have a three-pronged approach:
1\. _**Engage the Culture**_**** – Equipping God’s Church to be salt and light into the world. We work to change hearts and minds, build winning coalitions, grow networks of pastors, business leaders, and activists, and shape the battlespace.
2\. _**Develop Winning Policy**_ – We affect the laws of our state to protect human life, defend innocent children, secure school choice options, advance the cause of freedom, and more. Our team has an incredible track record of passing bills that protect faith, family, and freedom at the Capitol!
3\. _**Honor God in Elections**_**** – Personnel is policy, and we know that Christians are called to vote for candidates that will best fight for our worldview in office. Frontline is committed to ensuring Georgians Honor God with their vote, and our win-rate is second-to-none.
Between our two sister organizations – Frontline Policy Council and Frontline Policy Action – there is no other effort in Georgia that is doing what we do to serve and protect your family, forge a more God-honoring state, and glorify the Living King in the public square.
We are committed to boldness, to being an authentically Christian organization, and employing the strategies needed to win.

| | | Dear Peter,
What an incredible month! In the first 30 days since launching our campaign for San Diego County Supervisor, _**we have already raised over six figures**_ and earned major endorsements from key organizations.

I am proud to have the support of the San Diego Deputy District Attorneys Association, the Associated Builders and Contractors, the Lincoln Club of San Diego, and the New Majority. These early endorsements are evidence of the tremendous momentum and confidence behind our campaign and our commitment to the San Diego Region.

Reaching these milestones in the first 30 days of the campaign is truly remarkable, but we still have a long road ahead of us. To secure victory, we will need your continued support and your generous gifts of time and treasure.

You can sign up to volunteer and receive campaign updates on our [website](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=1177b1ce4e&e=784f78234b), and you can use [this link](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=99621a1889&e=784f78234b) to make a financial contribution to the campaign. Each and every contribution has a meaningful impact on the campaign and will help us change the future of San Diego County for the better.

Thank you for the amazing support to date, as well as the support I am sure you will continue to provide as we head into 2024. I look forward to seeing you on the campaign trail.
Sincerely,
Kevin

**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.
Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.
**My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**
Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a _billion_ dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.
**That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, friend, we can take him down.**

He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Roger serves on the Board of Trustees for the Bush School of Government and Public Service at Texas A&M University, the Texas Christian University Board of Trustees, and the National Football Foundation and College Football Hall of Fame Board of Directors.

My eyes nearly popped out of my head when the conversation turned to abortion. The candidates fought with each other over who could sign the most restrictive national abortion ban into law. Democrats have been calling out their dangerous agenda for the past year; at least now, Republicans aren’t trying to hide it. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- To hear reproductive rights talked about like that was infuriating and scary. If any of the candidates who were on stage (or the absent Donald Trump) get elected, it's bad news for choice and our basic freedoms. Mike Lawler continues to take a page from the national MAGA Republican playbook. He’s even gone as far as calling abortion rights a "distraction." Well, I have one thing to say to Mike and all of his extreme Republican buddies: It's not a “distraction” when women are dying because they don't have access to health care. It’s not a “distraction” to have bodily autonomy and the fundamental right to decide whether or not to be a parent. If you won’t fight to protect every person’s right to comprehensive health care, you’re unfit to serve. Our race is already shaping up to be one of the most competitive races in the country and we cannot risk losing any momentum. = Let’s do this, Mondaire Jones Mondaire Jones is running for Congress to finish the work he started last term.
