body:
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1447%2E120351%2Ex50i9K)
At COURIER, we're confronting Fox News head-on with trustworthy journalism to fight back against the right-wing media misinformation machine. [**Will you chip in today to support our nine local newsrooms?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230824?refcode=em20230824&amount=&refcode2=1447_120351_x50i9K&akid=1447%2E120351%2Ex50i9K) **[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230824?refcode=em20230824&amount=&refcode2=1447_120351_x50i9K&akid=1447%2E120351%2Ex50i9K)**

Peter,
Fox News still fears Donald Trump—and last night's Republican presidential debate proved it.
In a span of five months, Donald Trump has racked up four indictments and 91 criminal charges. Yet Fox News failed to ask the rest of the Republican field the tough, necessary questions about the implications of Donald Trump’s criminality. Instead, they chose to lob softball questions about UFOs and a viral country song.
**Peter, we're not surprised Fox News took it easy on Trump last night.** They’re terrified of losing Trump's supporters and the ratings they drive. It’s the same reason why personalities like Tucker Carlson and Sean Hannity aggressively pushed Trump’s dangerous election lies in 2020, even after they knew they were false.
**COURIER is the polar opposite of Fox News. We don’t pander to extremists, and we tell the truth, no matter what.** We correct misinformation. We don’t spread it just to make a quick buck.
[**Our fact-based, original reporting relies on grassroots support from people like you. To get the word out to NC voters and ensure they have what's needed to cast their ballots on election day, we must start our work early.

| Peter,

The NC GOP's Voter ID law is taking effect, and we're working to keep voters informed.

Beginning with the 2023 local elections, North Carolina voters are required to show a valid government-issued photo ID to cast a ballot.

While there are exceptions for those who can't get or provide a copy of their ID, it requires forms to be filled out, and the rules are confusing. More than 480,000 North Carolinians lack valid voter ID; _**worse, there's no doubt that this strict voter ID law will disproportionately impact Black and brown voters.**_

To get the word out to NC voters and ensure they have what's needed to cast their ballots on election day, we must start our work early. That’s why we need your help now more than ever. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Here comes the kitchen sink, team:

Once again, AIPAC and their right-wing donors are ramping up their efforts
to defeat progressive candidates for Congress — and this cycle, they
already have their targets set on Ilhan and our movement.

We've all seen AIPAC's playbook before, and we know it won't be long
before their super PAC begins pouring money into Minnesota's 5th district
to try and defeat us.^1 That's why we're urgently asking:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137342?refcode=em20230824-30523&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=30523%2E1203867%2EZcCn5u ]Can you rush a contribution — of $3 or anything you can —
to stand with Ilhan and Justice Democrats today so we have what it takes
to fight back? It's so important that our movement is in this together.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137342?refcode=em20230824-30523&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=30523%2E1203867%2EZcCn5u ]Donate $3

AIPAC is the same group that spent $350,000 in 2022 supporting Ilhan's
primary opponent through their "United Democracy Project" super PAC.

They're the same group that launched bigoted Islamophobic attack ads
against Ilhan,^2 and a member of whom's national council called Ilhan a
"terrorist" and suggested that she and Rashida Tlaib represent the Muslim
Brotherhood.^3

They're the same group whose super PAC, earlier this year, took a $1
million contribution from a billionaire Trump mega-donor, all to interfere
in Democratic primaries.^4

They're the same group whose super PAC didn't spend a dime helping any
Democrats defeat the GOP in 2022 — instead opting to endorse over 100
Republican insurrectionists and spending tens of millions trying to defeat
progressive candidates of color all across the country.

In many cases, it worked.

Now AIPAC and the United Democracy Project are already gearing up for
2024, and have begun recruiting challengers to run against Ilhan and her
fellow incumbent Squad members.

AIPAC continues to attack and spread bigoted lies about Ilhan and our
movement. We need your help fighting back, as soon as we can, and the only
way we do that is together. So please:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137342?refcode=em20230824-30523&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=30523%2E1203867%2EZcCn5u ]Can you split a contribution of $3 to Ilhan and Justice
Democrats? It's critical that we have the resources necessary to fight
back against AIPAC and everything the right wing will throw our way.

As always, thank you for being a part of our fight.

- Team Ilhan

Last night, during the first GOP presidential debate, Republicans once again reminded us what they really believe. We have a different vision for America. | | | Peter — Last night, during the first GOP presidential debate, Republicans once again reminded us what they really believe:
* They intend to ban abortion nationwide.
* They believe human caused climate change is not real.
* They want to eliminate the Department of Education and send troops to invade Mexico.
* And they almost all plan to support Trump again, even if he ends up convicted of trying to overturn the 2020 election in the next few months.

[](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUUlPXahTGguliG6TxgtMKgBNGLej2r4ZOOn-u6Pa4GEdYjGHaHzX8geaiUCTHVsf0jb8qrF6A_Tt4nyx9QXGvba-cjW1k7wKmxKK36BubBeIe3i9ysBrzfllfiZthU6uNSM4-ZhFGlx8w-3kvwiuaLcLdrkz-NwPcgdDcnFmoOZ0umlBQkhAV2cxE8G4o0H8t3sbVfJbE5lSAKZPAXKkJvxGTCBFMS3Jb7Ek0axGi-WFh2b1ZJutemihMQfkKrMfq99rU_bi4jlbCoFHoJqZinWlKBEJ8sJCsLqIp_wNlWU74IArWiUIGn3J9uHbNX1hs-gS06PN3CQluA61QadPRfULwELj4Pg1GGtKLBt095vI/3z0/ZA9aEH5DT3OnQ-T4QmllMg/h0/VtGSc2gWIIyKbER-yafYi6dUWxDwh0Eq9oT-nH2n8PQ) None of these beliefs enjoy popular support. But whether it's Trump or another nominee, the Republican Party is intent on forcing a deeply unpopular agenda on the American people in 2024 through demagoguery and attacks on democracy — backed by billionaires and megadonors who want to crush any candidates who actually stand with working people. We need to get ready right now to fight back the best way we know how — through organizing across our differences to build a movement that can take them on and win. **[Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can afford to fuel our electoral organizing so we can continue to fight back against the radical MAGA Trump movement and elect working class champions up and down the ballot in 2023 and 2024?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUUlPXahTGguliG6TxgtMKgBNGLej2r4ZOOn-u6Pa4GEcACPOP3ajhogYA2062RnWQjO5S0q08vt9hFJV4w-9wuWTJegLmp-wFW9upZe_1vdzzCEevovoSz6YmH3O9Hi5zAuKRLnyvc1d95O8XYCLjBMfBWYcuuM3HFgXhXZ5neI_3tdyV80n_YmRGm4vv5LhpcJ_sfibuI_ceTV_qTrIb4UZacRwCuUzdozR0hYJjwfd5j8m4q6WErr4GpqAcdec0KUhLHcWLfy3m0uXLTqTxf51evHuePO-MGtyMBW9S7bqpDv5WMhx0xdGSvrqv67yxy2B2slm6asBlaVGVKSaOW5Mo-v741-yQkPFnQ7NO3zk/3z0/ZA9aEH5DT3OnQ-T4QmllMg/h1/f0WjVCC-uoaZnKEbnVXdo0sc7WKgFb-bjFDbw6C-JuA)** **[Contribute $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUUlPXahTGguliG6TxgtMKgBNGLej2r4ZOOn-u6Pa4GEecVfBAGUKa3NY07VZnlzzJ3ImoLXam33J00pwWaNI9vmtb9UVevaZIbiH-eXPIgW0eulWnDGWnvzLb44CihRL88-wl3y2v7CbN5AZ2iu-7dGQs2ksujXB32fLXvEZpPa33XOYyqMWu53mhDH4IX3zAG9GnkmOV9YdTmyuBR0AA3Wwx2EggGgOMtLfLtgcIcYynyjVManv-FA3cxwdCvF5svwaJI7v_pY7xckNFF9yf28HW4DWkHy9WSYw60Nm_sRnkCQGOTiTHnhKv82YIZ5DhxYiwdSnKXoOXyxlM4kkekWpkkPJ_XJxYziUJTt5SEsE/3z0/ZA9aEH5DT3OnQ-T4QmllMg/h2/1z29yuok53D-oSzd92hwEXHRWBWEr1qUB7g_fyN0Ipw)** Last night, viewers were presented with a deeply disturbing view of America. There are critical elections happening over just the next few months that can bring us closer to the world that we seek.**
* In Rhode Island in two weeks, we can elect another working families champion to Congress in Aaron Regunberg, who has taken on Big Oil and expanded renewable energy.
* In Ohio, we are part of a grassroots movement to pass a state constitutional amendment to enshrine the right to an abortion this fall.
* In Virginia, we’re working around the clock to ensure that the last state in the South where abortion is legal and accessible stays that way by electing WFP champions to the state legislature this November.
* And in key places like Philadelphia, PA and Atlanta, GA, we’re on the ground every day, organizing around campaigns that will improve the everyday lives of working people and mobilize more voters to the polls in 2023, 2024 and beyond.

A vision of the multiracial working class coming together to build a movement of our own — one that believes that the climate crisis is an emergency, that our votes should be protected, and that people who can get pregnant should have control over their own bodies. And we don’t have to wait till next year to make inroads. There are critical elections happening over just the next few months that can bring us closer to the world that we seek. In Rhode Island in two weeks, we can elect another working families champion to Congress in Aaron Regunberg, who has taken on Big Oil and expanded renewable energy. In Ohio, we are part of a grassroots movement to pass a state constitutional amendment to enshrine the right to an abortion this fall. In Virginia, we’re working around the clock to ensure that the last state in the South where abortion is legal and accessible stays that way by electing WFP champions to the state legislature this November. And in key places like Philadelphia, PA and Atlanta, GA, we’re on the ground every day, organizing around campaigns that will improve the everyday lives of working people and mobilize more voters to the polls in 2023, 2024 and beyond. With your support, we can elect working class champions up-and-down the ballot who will fight for our values — not the values we saw on display last night. Friend, When I was five years old, I fled the Iranian revolution with my family, carrying nothing more than a stuffed elephant. **Today, I'm running for Congress.** The fact that I'm here today is an American Dream realized, friend. I was undocumented until I was 16 years old. **But these challenges helped make me the person I am today. Then, in 2020, we made history. I was elected to the West Hollywood City Council, becoming the first woman of color in history to hold that office, as well as the first openly-LGBTQ Iranian to hold public office in the world. name: Joe Kent
subject: My letter to the editor.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund
body:
Dear Peter,
_The Chronicle_ just published my Letter to the Editor exposing Marie Perez's hypocrisy on veterans issues.
If you believe we need to send someone who will fight for veterans' healthcare, please help me get to Washington by contributing to my campaign at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/46536ApGujsonyMU04sHbA/g8IycJshRcPDtg0WdQGTjQ).
You can read my letter below:
_U.S. Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez recently voted with every Democrat against a bill to fully fund the Veterans Administration, making it clear that she is comfortable with denying wounded U.S. Military veterans and the children of those killed in the service of our nation without compensation or medical care. _
_When we send our troops off to war, the American people promise that we will take care of them and their families if they are wounded or killed. Marie and every Democrat broke that sacred promise. She claimed the bill did not include enough funding, but it allocated $10 billion more than the Biden Administration requested for VA spending. Marie previously stated she supported fully funding the VA, but that was a lie._
_Adding insult to injury, Marie has continued to vote to keep our troops involved in endless wars overseas. Earlier this year, she voted against removing U.S. Armed Forces from Syria, and later a U.S. Military helicopter crashed in Syria and 22 service members were injured. _
_Marie 's voting record is clear: She is willing to send our troops off to fight and die but is not willing to compensate our troops for the cost of the wars she votes for but has never served in._
_Marie also voted against repealing Biden 's pistol brace ban, a policy that affects thousands of disabled veterans who rely on stabilizing pistol braces. Marie wants to brand disabled veterans felons for simply owning a pistol brace. _
_This is hypocrisy at its most outrageous: Marie votes to deprive veterans of medical care and access to firearms while voting to keep them involved in wars overseas._
_Marie routinely claims I do not know what it is like to "work for a living." I enlisted in the U.S. military at age 18 and served over 20 years in Special Forces and deployed to combat in the Middle East 11 times for our nation. Marie's life experience is limited to attending Reed College, an elite liberal private university that costs $60 thousand in tuition per year and masquerading in her husband's coveralls._
_She is not working for the interests of the people in her district -- she is working for her donors. Marie takes corporate PAC money routed through other PACs. She is co-chair of the Blue Dog coalition, and the Blue Dog PAC accepts contributions from defense contractors like Raytheon Technologies._
_Marie is working for special interests and D.C. elites, not the thousands of veterans in her district who rely on the VA for healthcare. I support fully funding the VA, expanding access to Tricare, and strengthening Congressional oversight of the VA system. As someone who receives my healthcare from the VA and Tricare, I understand the importance of ensuring our nation 's veterans have access to quality healthcare._
Marie Perez is not working for the thousands of veterans in her district. She has voted time and time again against the interests of the district, from supporting Biden's pistol brace ban to voting against healthcare for veterans.
When I get to DC, I promise to fight for the values of Washington's 3rd District and protect our treasured freedoms.
Help me with a donation today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/46536ApGujsonyMU04sHbA/g8IycJshRcPDtg0WdQGTjQ).
Will you please help me meet our goal so we can send a common-sense conservative to Congress?
Respectfully,
Joe Kent
PS - Please help me defeat Marie Perez by donating today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/46536ApGujsonyMU04sHbA/g8IycJshRcPDtg0WdQGTjQ).
Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund

subject: Your Signature is Needed: Monarch butterflies officially declared endangered
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1946291?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) OFFICIALLY declared monarch butterflies ENDANGERED. But Bayer-Monsanto is still producing butterfly-harming Roundup!** There’s no mystery as to why monarchs are disappearing. Greedy Big Ag corporations continue to profit off of BUTTERFLY-HARMING pesticides like glyphosate. Glyphosate, the main ingredient in Bayer-Monsanto’s Roundup, is **DECIMATING** milkweed. And milkweed is the _**only food source for young monarch caterpillars.**_ **With milkweed plants disappearing, we’re seeing devastating declines in monarch populations.** This is serious, Friend. So serious that the IUCN has OFFICIALLY declared monarch butterflies ENDANGERED! Why, then, is Bayer-Monsanto still producing Roundup? The answer is simple: Big Ag corporations care more about lining their pockets than saving monarchs and our planet. [**We need 73 more activists from your area to URGE Bayer-Monsanto to STOP Roundup production before it’s too late to save monarch butterflies -- will you add your name NOW? >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1946292?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1946293?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Monarch butterflies are essential pollinators that our ecosystems rely on. But over **850 MILLION milkweed plants** have already completely VANISHED from the U.S. in the last 20 years -- and we’ve also lost _**90% of the North American monarch butterfly population.**_
Glyphosate isn’t just hurting monarchs, either. It’s a probable carcinogen. And it’s associated with**reproductive harm in people, disruption of the gut microbiome, kidney toxicity, and fatty liver disease!** Is this really the kind of chemical we want on our farms and lawns?
We don’t want to see a world without monarch butterflies, Friend, and we know you don’t either. That’s why we need you to act **URGENTLY** to protect monarchs and human health. [**Please, will you be one of 73 activists from your area to sign NOW and DEMAND Bayer-Monsanto halts production of butterfly-harming Roundup before we lose monarchs forever? >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1946294?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

name: Katie Porter
subject: Vivek Ramaswamy’s take on single women
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=28732%2E3422442%2E06hTpq)
There was a lot of BS flying around last night’s GOP debate, but this line from Vivek Ramaswamy caught my attention: **_"The government pays single women more not to have a man in the house."_**
This is a demeaning and frankly, flat-out false statement. As one of Congress' only single moms of school-aged kids, I've called attention to how our tax code unfairly punishes single parents. When the Child Tax Credit was enacted during the pandemic, for example, married parents making less than $150,000 per year qualified for monthly payments. But for single parent families, you only qualified if you made less than $112,500 per year.
I fought this unequal treatment because there’s no “single parent discount” for groceries, kids’ shoes, rent, or childcare. **By punishing single parent families, we punish the children whose families are often most in need of assistance.**
**When I was advocating against a single parent penalty, I asked why it existed in the first place. The answer was "no one's asked about it before."** That might be because no single mom of young kids had ever served in Congress—until I was elected in 2018. If elected to the Senate, I'd be the first single mom of school-aged kids to serve there too.
We don’t need guys like Vivek demonizing millions of single parents in America who need their government to work for them—we need leaders on the national level who will fight for _all_ families and champion investments in schools, affordable childcare, and in paid leave policies.
[**That's why I'm running for the U.S. Senate, and I'd be so honored to have you on our team.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230824-1?refcode=EMAK24_1_GOP_20230824_V1_F&refcode2=28732_3422442_06hTpq&akid=28732%2E3422442%2E06hTpq)

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

In response, the State Freedom Caucus Network [released the following statement](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c58cff6a-798d-4350-ab7a-ae2b7323b472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):

We wholly reject the notion that he should be charged with any crime and we call on all Americans to express their anger at the deliberate undermining of our justice system and demand that this case be thrown out. We are proud to continue our association with Mark Meadows and we will stand with the entire Meadows family until this ugly chapter in our Country's history is closed._

Ruben Gallego can happily run for Senate in California where his belittling and condescending views would be welcomed by a lawless state being overrun by unchecked crime. In Arizona and elsewhere, we are proud of our heritage. I’m running for the United States Senate to protect our Second Amendment rights from far-left Democrats who have no respect for our individual liberties or the Constitution. If you’re offended by my opponent’s remarks, then please to defeat him in the next U.S. Senate election. If his ignorant comments about people who own guns sets off alarm bells, that’s a good thing. If Ruben Gallego is elected to the U.S. Senate, you can count on him being the face of the anti-gun/2A repeal caucus in the Senate. If you’re interested in ensuring gun-hating, classist Democrats like him never make it to the Senate, . The types of comments made by my opponent perfectly sum up the disdain Democrats hold for anyone who dares to disagree with their worldview. As the Sheriff of Arizona’s 3rd largest country, I can guarantee I’ll never backdown from the fight to protect our right to bear arms. That’s why it’s critical we get the support we need to fend off gun-hating Democrats who would launch an all-out assault on our Constitutional liberties. We always knew Democrats felt this way about us; it’s just jarring to hear them say it outload. Thank you, Sheriff Mark Lamb Republican for U.S. Senate Follow Sheriff Lamb On Social Media | | | ---|---|--- ../../../../../../../Desktop/Desktop/Mark Lamb/Templates/April Pelosi/www.alekfororegon.com Meet Sheriff Lamb: GOD. FAMILY. FREEDOM. Sheriff Mark Lamb is a husband, father, grandfather, and God-fearing patriot. From Hawaii to Manila, Arizona, Mark Lamb's rich experirences inspired his life of service. As the 24th Sheriff of Pinal County, Arizona, he drives a powerful agenda to ensure community safety and prosperity. Sheriff Lamb trained with the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office Deputy Academy and was named Valedictorian of his class. He was hired by the Salt River Pima-Maricopa Indian Community, where he excelled as a police officer and was named Rookie of the Year. The following year, he received the Officer of the Year award. He was later promoted as a Detective to the Gang Enforcement Unit and in his first year was named Detective of the Year. | Paid for by Mark Lamb for Senate

Hey Peter,
It’s Anderson, Chair of the North Carolina Democratic Party. I ran for this seat back in 2022 because I was tired of the narrative that Democrats couldn’t win in North Carolina, and I was tired of folks saying that our communities didn’t deserve to be heard.
I knew I needed to be part of the action in our state to make change happen. And change is exactly what I’m trying to create as Chair of our Party. After the 2020 election, my friend Wiley Nickel was equally tired of hearing that Democrats couldn’t win here. After all, Joe Biden only ended up losing North Carolina by just over a point!
So Wiley decided to run, and he won the new 13th District in 2022. Democrats barely lost the House, and Wiley defeated a dangerous extremist in Bo Hines and proved his strength as a candidate. And that’s got the GOP worried.
Kevin McCarthy is going to do everything he can to defeat Wiley in 2024, but I’m telling you we can protect his seat if we all work together. So, I’m asking if y’all can split a donation between the North Carolina Democratic Party and Wiley’s campaign to protect his seat and help us elect Democrats across our state in 2024. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2308-q3-wn-ncdp?refcode=230824-email]

I believe in the power of people and collective action. And I know in my bones that we can make sure it’s a battleground every single year by running strong candidates in every race up and down the ballot and putting in the time and effort to organize and mobilize our friends, family, and communities.
Wiley is a perfect example of a candidate who saw an opportunity to win a race and pick up a seat – and he took it. So I’m asking you to stand with me and stand with him in 2024.
Split a donation of any amount you can afford between the NC Dems and Wiley Nickel and we will take back the House and turn North Carolina blue together. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2308-q3-wn-ncdp?refcode=230824-email]

In a groundbreaking decision, a judge in Montana ruled in favor of young climate activists who accused the state elected officials of violating their rights to a clean and healthy environment. I am very proud and grateful to young people who are willing to fight for a livable future, even when that means taking on the fossil fuel industry. This ruling should send a clear message - everyone has the right to clean air, clean water, and an environment where they can flourish. But we know that for every victory the climate movement wins, the fossil fuel industry has a plan to fight back. = | = We are doing the most important work of our lifetime and will do whatever it takes to defeat the fossil fuel industry and replace their allies in elected office with climate champions. | | In case you didn’t catch last night’s Republican debate, we’ll fill you in: **Our democracy isn’t a priority for the Republican presidential candidates. In fact, they have proven records of attacking it.** A majority of the candidates weren’t willing to denounce Donald Trump’s attempts to overturn the results of a free and fair election — six out of eight said they’d still support him as the party’s nominee if he’s convicted. They didn’t explain how they’d ensure that anti-democratic threats like this never happen again. And they have extensive records of attacking the freedom to vote. So we’re fighting back — building up our large-scale organizing program to protect voters’ access to the ballot box from these extremists, mitigate any voter suppression attempts that come from their allies, and elect voting rights champions up and down the ballot. It’s not _just_ that these Republican presidential candidates don’t have concrete plans to protect our democracy.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: An urgent threat to our freedoms
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Democrats have not prioritized changing the rules and institutions that act as roadblocks to progress.
#
Peter,
Make no mistake about it: **The Supreme Court is a super-legislature with a deeply corrupt and extreme far-right majority.**
We all saw Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell pack the Court with three ultra-conservative justices, each serving life appointments. And during the short amount of time they’ve been on the Court, they’ve made horrendous decisions, **overturning _Roe v. Wade_ just to name one.**
**It’s time to do something about it, Peter.** We can muster our collective power to call on Congress to add four seats to the Supreme Court by passing the Judiciary Act. This isn’t a radical idea, and it doesn't take a constitutional amendment. **[If you stand with us, please rush a contribution to our campaign to fix our Supreme Court and re-instill trust, honor, and integrity in our legislative systems.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44740?refcode=em20230824-2847&t=1&akid=2847%2E420207%2EL6pw-d)**
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44740?refcode=em20230824-2847&t=2&akid=2847%2E420207%2EL6pw-d)**
Democrats have not prioritized changing the rules and institutions that act as roadblocks to progress. Take the filibuster for example: A rule not found anywhere in the Constitution and born out of the Jim Crow era continues to hold back common-sense bills, basic voting rights protections, pre-K for all, and more.
Meanwhile, when Republicans found rules that didn’t work in their favor, **they changed them.** By shrinking the Supreme Court to eight seats and ramming through the nomination of the anti-abortion judge Amy Coney Barret just days before the presidential election – despite blocking Merrick Garland for that same reason – Republicans were successful at unwinding the critical fabric of our democracy.
The Supreme Court is an urgent threat to our freedoms, and we need a proper response, Peter. **[If you want to take action and fix the Supreme Court, please consider making a contribution to boost our fight against Mitch McConnell’s far-right Supreme Court.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44740?refcode=em20230824-2847&t=3&akid=2847%2E420207%2EL6pw-d)**
Together,
Pramila Jayapal

Four More is a progressive project with the goal to ensure Congress does everything in its power to pass the Judiciary Act. **[If you want to join this fight, click here to sign up and stay involved in our collective efforts.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44741?source=em20230824-2847&t=4&akid=2847%2E420207%2EL6pw-d)**

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Re: First GOP presidential debate in Milwaukee
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
Hi Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin.

Last night, the Republican presidential candidates descended on Milwaukee for their first nationally-televised debate. Wisconsin is the premier battleground state in this critical election, and the GOP is laser-focused on putting every possible resource into flipping our state — and my Senate seat — red. Let me explain:

Wisconsin’s 10 electoral votes were the tipping point in the last two presidential elections. Our state put Joe Biden over the top in 2020 and tipped the presidency to Donald Trump in 2016.

**Both elections were decided by less than 1% — that’s about 20,000 votes.**

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

| | | Friend, It’s almost cliche to think of Congress as a dysfunctional organization incapable of doing anything worthwhile because of constant political maneuvering and partisan bickering. And to be fair, that does accurately describe the U.S. House for the past eight months because of the leverage that extremists have over Speaker Kevin McCarthy. **But last year, Congress was the most productive it’s been in decades.** Conservative and progressive publications alike recognized just how much Congress accomplished by passing legislation to invest in infrastructure, bring jobs back to the U.S., and reduce prescription drug costs: “Congress was historically productive.”
_Washington Examiner_ | August 11, 2022 “We just had the most productive Congress since the Eisenhower Era.”
_The Hill_ | September 12, 2022 “Congress proved to be productive as Democrats navigated with slim majority.”
_The Washington Post_ | September 30, 2022 Last Congress, lawmakers passed transformational legislation. Some of the highlights were:
* **The CHIPS & Science Act** to bring semiconductor manufacturing jobs back to the United States;
* **The Inflation Reduction Act** to lower prescription drug costs and make historic investments in combating climate change; and
* **The Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act** (our favorite) to invest in building up the nation’s ports and shipping infrastructure, airports, highways, electric vehicle charging stations, power grids, and rural broadband access.

Last year, we helped elect Mary Peltola to the U.S. House, and she advanced thoughtful bills after her September swearing in. Now, it’s voices like hers that are helping to mitigate the damage extremists can do in Washington. **We’re proud that Alaska is leading the way in rejecting extremism — and that we at Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund have been working to support common-sense leaders who have enacted common-sense laws.** But we have more work to do to push back against the extremism in the House this Congress, and we need all hands on deck as we rally to protect good governance so we can get back to making meaningful progress.
